CEI ordering \u2014 state changes first, NFT mint last:        1. `stakingV10.relock` \u2014 drives CSS's `createNewPositionFromExisting`           which itself asserts the new slot is empty           (`positions[newTokenId].identityId == 0`). That assertion is           a CSS-state check, not an NFT-existence check, so the new           NFT does NOT need to exist yet.        2. `_burn(oldTokenId)` \u2014 removes the old NFT after CSS has           moved the position. A mid-call revert leaves BOTH NFT and           position state intact at the old tokenId.        3. `_mint(msg.sender, newTokenId)` \u2014 last, so the wrapper           never observes a half-built burn-mint state. `_mint`           (not `_safeMint`) is intentional: contract callers           without `IERC721Receiver` are part of the supported           caller set, including any contract holding an existing           position from a prior `_mint`-era relock."},"safeTransferFrom(address,address,uint256)":{"details":"Safely transfers `tokenId` token from `from` to `to`, checking first that contract recipients are aware of the ERC-721 protocol to prevent tokens from being forever locked. ContractStatus(hubAddress) ERC721(\"DKG Staker Conviction\", \"DKGSC\") {}\n\n    function initialize() public onlyHub {\n        stakingV10 = StakingV10(hub.getContractAddress(\"StakingV10\"));\n        convictionStakingStorage = ConvictionStakingStorage(hub.getContractAddress(\"ConvictionStakingStorage\"));\n        chronos = Chronos(hub.getContractAddress(\"Chronos\"));\n        randomSamplingStorage = RandomSamplingStorage(hub.getContractAddress(\"RandomSamplingStorage\"));\n        shardingTableStorage = ShardingTableStorage(hub.getContractAddress(\"ShardingTableStorage\"));\n        shardingTableContract = ShardingTable(hub.getContractAddress(\"ShardingTable\"));\n        askContract = Ask(hub.getContractAddress(\"Ask\"));\n        parametersStorage = ParametersStorage(hub.getContractAddress(\"ParametersStorage\"));\n        profileStorage = ProfileStorage(hub.getContractAddress(\"ProfileStorage\"));\n        tokenContract = IERC20(hub.getContractAddress(\"Token\"));\n    }\n\n    // M5 \u2014 `name()` (ERC-721) is deliberately NOT overridden; it returns the\n    //      constructor-supplied collection name (\"DKG Staker Conviction\")\n    //      that wallets display. The dev-facing contract id lives on\n    //      `contractName()`.\n    function contractName() external pure returns (string memory) {\n        return _CONTRACT_NAME;\n    }\n\n    function version() external pure virtual returns (string memory) {\n        return _VERSION;\n    }\n\n    // ========================================================================\n    // Admin gate \u2014 used by the admin drains (`adminDrainBatch` /\n    // `adminMigrateToCredit` / `adminDrainOperatorFeesBatch`) and `finalizeMigrationBatch`\n    // ========================================================================\n\n    /// @dev Matches the ownership + multisig pattern used by other admin\n    ///      entry points on V10 contracts (e.g. `RandomSampling`).\n    modifier onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner() {\n        address hubOwner = hub.owner();\n        if (msg.sender != hubOwner && !_isMultiSigOwner(hubOwner)) {\n            revert HubLib.UnauthorizedAccess(\"Only Hub Owner or Multisig Owner\");\n        }\n        _;\n    }\n\n    function _isMultiSigOwner(address multiSigAddress) internal view returns (bool) {\n        try ICustodian(multiSigAddress).getOwners() returns (address[] memory owners) {\n            for (uint256 i = 0; i < owners.length; i++) {\n                if (msg.sender == owners[i]) return true;\n            }\n        } catch {\n            // Not a multisig or call reverted; treat as not an owner.\n        }\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    // ========================================================================\n    // Conviction multiplier tier ladder \u2014 delegates to CSS (v2.1.0)\n    // ========================================================================\n    //\n    // Source of truth is `ConvictionStakingStorage._tiers`. The baseline\n    // ladder seeded at `CSS.initialize()` is {0, 1, 3, 6, 12} mapping to\n    // {1x, 1.5x, 2x, 3.5x, 6x} and {0, 30d, 90d, 180d, 360d} wall-clock\n    // lock durations.\n    // New tiers can be appended by the HubOwner via `CSS.addTier`; this\n    // helper picks them up automatically via the storage read.\n    //\n    // Discrete, exact-match semantics \u2014 no snap-down. An unregistered\n    // `lockTier` reverts `InvalidLockTier()`.\n    //\n    // Tier 0 \u2192 1x is a first-class tier, not an edge case:\n    //   V10 policy is that every staking position is an NFT, including\n    //   no-lock liquid stake. Tier 0 is valid on every entry point that\n    //   takes a lockTier:\n    //     - createConviction(_, _, 0): fresh mint at rest state.\n    //     - relock(_, 0)             : post-expiry opt-out to permanent 1x.\n    //     - _convertToNFT(_, _, 0)   : V8 migrants landing at rest state.\n    //     - any caller reading a live position's current tier after its\n    //       lock has expired back to the rest state.\n    //   Semantics: 1.0x multiplier, `expiryTimestamp == 0` (permanent, no\n    //   boost decay ever fires), TRAC withdrawable at any time via the\n    //   atomic `withdraw` path (D14 \u2014 no delay, the lock IS the delay\n    //   and tier 0 has no lock).\n    //\n    //   `createConviction` still rejects DEACTIVATED tiers at the CSS\n    //   layer: `CSS.createPosition` requires `active == true` whenever\n    //   `migrationEpoch == 0`. Tier 0 is seeded active at\n    //   `CSS.initialize()` and a HubOwner could deactivate it via\n    //   `deactivateTier(0)` if the no-lock product is ever retired;\n    //   relock and V8\u2192V10 migration paths bypass the `active` check\n    //   (existence only) so users can renew under a tier they\n    //   originally committed to.\n    //\n    // @param lockTier Tier id; must exist in `CSS._tiers`. Maps to the\n    //                 wall-clock duration registered there. NOT a Chronos\n    //                 epoch count.\n    // @return multiplier18 1e18-scaled tier multiplier.\n    function _convictionMultiplier(uint256 lockTier) internal view returns (uint256) {\n        ConvictionStakingStorage.TierConfig memory tc =\n            convictionStakingStorage.getTier(uint40(lockTier));\n        if (!tc.exists) revert InvalidLockTier();\n        return uint256(tc.multiplier18);\n    }\n\n    // ========================================================================\n    // Entry points \u2014 thin wrappers that forward to `StakingV10`\n    // ========================================================================\n    //\n    // The NFT contract is a dumb ownership receipt. All position business\n    // logic (stake bookkeeping, conviction math, reward accrual, withdrawal\n    // state machine, V8 migration) lives in `StakingV10`, which is gated by\n    // `onlyConvictionNFT` so only this contract can invoke it. Each wrapper:\n    //\n    //   1. Validates ownership (`ownerOf == msg.sender`) on mutating calls.\n    //   2. For mint paths, fails fast on `lockTier` via `_convictionMultiplier`.\n    //   3. Mints / burns the ERC-721 token as needed.\n    //   4. Forwards to the matching `StakingV10` method with `msg.sender`\n    //      passed explicitly as the `staker` argument (StakingV10 never\n    //      trusts `tx.origin`).\n    //   5. Emits a wrapper-layer mirror event for NFT-contract watchers \u2014\n    //      the authoritative event for off-chain accounting comes from the\n    //      `StakingV10` / `ConvictionStakingStorage` layer.\n    //\n    // TRAC never touches this contract: at `createConviction` the user has\n    // approved `StakingV10` directly, and `StakingV10.stake` pulls TRAC via\n    // `token.transferFrom(staker, convictionStorage, amount)` \u2014 CSS is\n    // the v4.0.0 TRAC vault. The NFT layer only mints/burns ERC-721 tokens.\n\n    /// @notice Mint a fresh NFT-backed staking position on `identityId` with\n    ///         `amount` TRAC under the `lockTier` tier. Valid tiers are\n    ///         whatever `CSS.getTier(lockTier).active == true`; the seeded\n    ///         baseline is tier 0 (rest state, 1x, no lock) plus 1/3/6/12\n    ///         (30d/90d/180d/366d \u2192 1.5x/2x/3.5x/6x). All tiers \u2014 including\n    ///         tier 0 \u2014 produce an NFT; every V10 staking position is an NFT.\n    function createConviction(\n        uint72 identityId,\n        uint96 amount,\n        uint40 lockTier\n    ) external returns (uint256 tokenId) {\n        if (identityId == 0) revert InvalidIdentityId();\n        if (amount == 0) revert ZeroAmount();\n        // Fail-fast on tiers that don't exist in `CSS._tiers` (e.g. 2, 4,\n        // 7, 13): `_convictionMultiplier` reverts `InvalidLockTier()` when\n        // the tier is unregistered. Tier 0 (rest state, 1x) is a valid\n        // registered tier \u2014 V10 policy is that no-lock stake is a first-\n        // class NFT position, not a blocked state. Deactivated tiers are\n        // rejected further downstream by `CSS.createPosition` via\n        // `_requireActiveTier` (fresh stakes only \u2014 migrationEpoch == 0).\n        _convictionMultiplier(lockTier);\n\n        tokenId = ++nextTokenId;\n        // CEI ordering: settle CSS state and pull TRAC FIRST, then `_mint`\n        // last so the wrapper never observes a half-built (NFT-without-\n        // position) state. `_mint` (not `_safeMint`) is intentional:\n        // contract callers without `IERC721Receiver` are part of the\n        // supported caller set (multisigs, treasuries, AA wallets, etc.).\n        stakingV10.stake(msg.sender, tokenId, identityId, amount, lockTier);\n        _mint(msg.sender, tokenId);\n\n        emit PositionCreated(msg.sender, tokenId, identityId, amount, lockTier);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Post-expiry re-commit of an existing position to a new lock\n    ///         tier. Raw stake unchanged; multiplier + expiry shift.\n    ///\n    /// @dev D21 \u2014 NFTs are ephemeral. Relock burns the old NFT and mints a\n    ///      fresh one at `newTokenId = ++nextTokenId`. `StakingV10.relock`\n    ///      drives the D23 `createNewPositionFromExisting` primitive on CSS,\n    ///      which preserves `cumulativeRewardsClaimed`, `lastClaimedEpoch`,\n    ///      and `migrationEpoch` on the new tokenId; indexers that need to\n    ///      track a delegator's history across relocks follow the\n    ///      `PositionRelocked(oldTokenId, newTokenId, ...)` event surfaced\n    ///      here (and the CSS-level `PositionReplaced` with the full reward\n    ///      stat continuity).\n    ///\n    ///      CEI ordering \u2014 state changes first, NFT mint last:\n    ///        1. `stakingV10.relock` \u2014 drives CSS's `createNewPositionFromExisting`\n    ///           which itself asserts the new slot is empty\n    ///           (`positions[newTokenId].identityId == 0`). That assertion is\n    ///           a CSS-state check, not an NFT-existence check, so the new\n    ///           NFT does NOT need to exist yet.\n    ///        2. `_burn(oldTokenId)` \u2014 removes the old NFT after CSS has\n    ///           moved the position. A mid-call revert leaves BOTH NFT and\n    ///           position state intact at the old tokenId.\n    ///        3. `_mint(msg.sender, newTokenId)` \u2014 last, so the wrapper\n    ///           never observes a half-built burn-mint state. `_mint`\n    ///           (not `_safeMint`) is intentional: contract callers\n    ///           without `IERC721Receiver` are part of the supported\n    ///           caller set, including any contract holding an existing\n    ///           position from a prior `_mint`-era relock.\n    function relock(uint256 oldTokenId, uint40 newLockTier) external returns (uint256 newTokenId) {\n        if (ownerOf(oldTokenId) != msg.sender) revert NotPositionOwner();\n        // Fail-fast on unregistered tiers (e.g. 2, 4, 7). Tier 0 is valid:\n        // relock to the rest state is a legitimate post-expiry opt-out to\n        // permanent 1x with no new lock. Deactivated tiers are allowed on\n        // the relock path (existence-only check in CSS) so users can\n        // renew under a tier they originally committed to even if it has\n        // since been retired.\n        _convictionMultiplier(newLockTier);\n\n        newTokenId = ++nextTokenId;\n        stakingV10.relock(msg.sender, oldTokenId, newTokenId, newLockTier);\n        _burn(oldTokenId);\n        _mint(msg.sender, newTokenId);\n\n        emit PositionRelocked(oldTokenId, newTokenId, newLockTier);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Move a position from its current node to `newIdentityId`.\n    ///         Per-node effective stake moves; global totals invariant.\n    ///         The tokenId is STABLE \u2014 the caller's NFT asset identity is\n    ///         preserved across the redelegation, only the node it points\n    ///         at changes.\n    ///\n    /// @dev D25 \u2014 in-place node swap. Unlike `relock` (which burns and\n    ///      mints because tier / multiplier / expiry all change), a\n    ///      redelegation is a routing decision: the lock clock keeps\n    ///      ticking on the same `expiryTimestamp`, the reward cursor\n    ///      (`lastClaimedEpoch`, `cumulativeRewardsClaimed`,\n    ///      `migrationEpoch`) carries through unchanged, and the tokenId\n    ///      itself persists so wallets and marketplaces see a stable\n    ///      asset. StakingV10 drives the CSS `updateOnRedelegate`\n    ///      primitive which moves per-node effective-stake contributions\n    ///      and pending expiry deltas across at `currentEpoch`.\n    function redelegate(uint256 tokenId, uint72 newIdentityId) external {\n        if (ownerOf(tokenId) != msg.sender) revert NotPositionOwner();\n        if (newIdentityId == 0) revert InvalidIdentityId();\n        // Capture the pre-call `identityId` so the wrapper-layer event can\n        // surface both endpoints.\n        uint72 oldIdentityId = convictionStakingStorage.getPosition(tokenId).identityId;\n\n        stakingV10.redelegate(msg.sender, tokenId, newIdentityId);\n\n        emit PositionRedelegated(tokenId, oldIdentityId, newIdentityId);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Atomic full withdrawal. Pays out the position's entire `raw`\n    ///         balance (post-auto-claim) to the owner and burns the NFT in\n    ///         a single transaction. Caller must own the NFT.\n    ///\n    /// @dev D14 \u2014 no request/cancel/finalize dance, no address-timer\n    ///      delay. Pre-expiry reverts `LockStillActive` at StakingV10.\n    ///      Q3 \u2014 rewards are auto-claimed inside `StakingV10.withdraw`\n    ///      before the final drain, so the user sees a single button in\n    ///      the UI. Full-only by design (Q1) \u2014 a user wanting to keep\n    ///      some TRAC staked should withdraw and re-stake the remainder\n    ///      (tier 0 with 1x is effectively liquid).\n    function withdraw(uint256 tokenId) external returns (uint96 amount) {\n        if (ownerOf(tokenId) != msg.sender) revert NotPositionOwner();\n\n        // CEI ordering \u2014 the receipt NFT is dropped BEFORE the CSS\n        // teardown + TRAC payout run, so the on-chain ownership claim\n        // ends before any external token movement. ownerOf-gated\n        // re-entry paths on this contract (claim / withdraw / relock /\n        // redelegate) revert at the entry ownership check.\n        // StakingV10.withdraw gates on the CSS position (`pos.identityId\n        // == 0`), not NFT existence, so the teardown is unaffected.\n        _burn(tokenId);\n\n        amount = stakingV10.withdraw(msg.sender, tokenId);\n\n        emit PositionWithdrawn(tokenId, amount);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Walk unclaimed epochs for the position, accumulate reward,\n    ///         and bank it into the `ConvictionStakingStorage` rewards\n    ///         bucket. Updates `lastClaimedEpoch`.\n    function claim(uint256 tokenId) external {\n        if (ownerOf(tokenId) != msg.sender) revert NotPositionOwner();\n        stakingV10.claim(msg.sender, tokenId);\n        // No wrapper-layer event \u2014 `StakingV10.claim` emits `RewardsClaimed`\n        // with the amount already. The NFT layer does not duplicate reward\n        // accounting events.\n    }\n\n    // ========================================================================\n    // V8 \u2192 V10 \"pool & allocate\" migration\n    // ========================================================================\n    //\n    // Admin-push: the protocol drains EVERY wallet's V8 stake across\n    // its source nodes into that wallet's in-protocol migration credit, via\n    // `adminDrainBatch` (bulk) / `adminMigrateToCredit` (single delegator) \u2014\n    // both onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner. Users never drain themselves; they only\n    // call `allocate` to spend their pre-populated credit into V10 conviction\n    // positions (node + amount + tier), repeatably. A tier-6/12 allocation earns\n    // the conviction lock-credit (universal \u2014 no eligibility registry).\n    // Credit is non-withdrawable as credit; `allocate` is its only sink \u2014 but a\n    // tier-0 allocation carries no lock and is immediately withdrawable, so\n    // drained funds are always recoverable to the wallet in two txs. The credit\n    // ledger + drain/allocate workers live on CSS / StakingV10\n    // (onlyConvictionNFT); this wrapper owns the tokenId counter + ERC-721 mint\n    // and the owner gating.\n    //\n    // There is intentionally NO self-service drain: the off-chain sweep is the\n    // only path that empties V8, so its completeness (per-chain\n    // StakingStorage.getTotalStake() == 0) is a release gate before the V8\n    // `Staking` contract is unregistered.\n\n    /// @notice Single-delegator admin drain \u2014 move `delegator`'s V8 stake across\n    ///         `sourceNodes` into THEIR migration credit (no allocation). See\n    ///         `adminDrainBatch` for the bulk sweep. Gate:\n    ///         `onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner`. Reverts `NothingToMigrate` if nothing\n    ///         was drained (caller-error guard on an intentional single call).\n    function adminMigrateToCredit(\n        address delegator,\n        uint72[] calldata sourceNodes\n    ) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner returns (uint96 credited) {\n        // Benign: _drainAll calls only the onlyConvictionNFT worker over trusted\n        // storage (no callback); the event after it carries no reentrancy risk.\n        // slither-disable-next-line reentrancy-events\n        credited = _drainAll(delegator, sourceNodes);\n        if (credited == 0) revert NothingToMigrate();\n        emit MigrationStarted(delegator, credited);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Bulk admin-push drain. Each index `i` is ONE (delegator, node)\n    ///         pair \u2014 the flattened form matches the V8 storage key and the\n    ///         off-chain DelegatorsInfo enumeration, giving even per-pair gas so\n    ///         the driver packs uniform chunks. Pairs with nothing to drain are\n    ///         SKIPPED (not reverted), so a chunk mixing already-drained and\n    ///         fresh pairs still lands and re-running a chunk after a partial\n    ///         failure is safe (`drainV8ToCredit` is idempotent \u2014 a zeroed slot\n    ///         yields 0). Amounts are NOT passed in \u2014 they are read on-chain from\n    ///         V8 state, so the credit is exactly what was drained. Gate:\n    ///         `onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner`. Emits one `MigrationStarted` per pair\n    ///         that moved credit.\n    function adminDrainBatch(\n        address[] calldata delegators,\n        uint72[] calldata identityIds\n    ) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        uint256 n = delegators.length;\n        require(n == identityIds.length, \"length mismatch\");\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n            // Benign: owner-only batch; the callee is onlyConvictionNFT over\n            // trusted protocol storage, moves plain ERC20 TRAC (no callback),\n            // and is idempotent \u2014 no value-reentrancy vector, event-after-call ok.\n            // slither-disable-next-line calls-loop,reentrancy-events\n            uint96 t = stakingV10.drainV8ToCredit(delegators[i], identityIds[i]);\n            if (t > 0) emit MigrationStarted(delegators[i], t);\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Bulk operator-fee drain \u2014 companion to `adminDrainBatch` for the\n    ///         node side. Each index `i` is ONE (node, operator) pair: the V8\n    ///         operator fee on `identityIds[i]` (resting balance + open\n    ///         withdrawal request) is moved into `operators[i]`'s migration\n    ///         credit (the SAME bucket as delegator\n    ///         stake). `operators[i]` MUST currently hold ADMIN_KEY on the node\n    ///         (validated in `StakingV10.drainOperatorFeeToCredit`, which\n    ///         REVERTS a stale/wrong address) \u2014 so a mis-resolved operator\n    ///         reverts the whole batch rather than crediting wrongly; the\n    ///         off-chain sweep re-resolves and retries. Nodes with no fee are\n    ///         SKIPPED (idempotent: a re-drained node yields 0). Amounts are\n    ///         read on-chain, never passed in. Gate: `onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner`.\n    ///         Emits one `OperatorFeeMigrated` per node that moved credit.\n    function adminDrainOperatorFeesBatch(\n        uint72[] calldata identityIds,\n        address[] calldata operators\n    ) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        uint256 n = identityIds.length;\n        require(n == operators.length, \"length mismatch\");\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n            // Benign: owner-only batch; the callee is onlyConvictionNFT over\n            // trusted protocol storage, moves plain ERC20 TRAC (no callback),\n            // and is idempotent \u2014 no value-reentrancy vector, event-after-call ok.\n            // slither-disable-next-line calls-loop,reentrancy-events\n            uint96 t = stakingV10.drainOperatorFeeToCredit(identityIds[i], operators[i]);\n            if (t > 0) emit OperatorFeeMigrated(identityIds[i], operators[i], t);\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Self-service straggler backstop. The connected wallet drains ITS\n    ///         OWN V8 stake (keyed by `keccak256(msg.sender)`) across `sourceNodes`\n    ///         into its own migration credit. Admin-push (`adminDrainBatch`) is the\n    ///         primary path; this exists so any delegator the off-chain sweep\n    ///         missed can never be stranded. Permissionless and self-validating \u2014\n    ///         you can only ever drain the V8 key that hashes from your own\n    ///         address, into your own credit. Works after V8 Staking is\n    ///         unregistered (the drain goes through StakingStorage directly); the\n    ///         worker's freeze gate means it is only callable once V8 Staking is\n    ///         frozen (so it cannot race live V8 reward/sharding accounting).\n    function selfMigrate(uint72[] calldata sourceNodes) external returns (uint96 credited) {\n        credited = _drainAll(msg.sender, sourceNodes);\n        if (credited == 0) revert NothingToMigrate();\n        emit MigrationStarted(msg.sender, credited);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Self-service operator-fee backstop: the node admin (msg.sender,\n    ///         validated against ADMIN_KEY inside `drainOperatorFeeToCredit`)\n    ///         drains the node's V8 operator fee into its own migration credit.\n    ///         Same freeze-gated, post-unregister-safe properties as `selfMigrate`.\n    function selfMigrateOperatorFee(uint72 identityId) external returns (uint96 credited) {\n        credited = stakingV10.drainOperatorFeeToCredit(identityId, msg.sender);\n        if (credited == 0) revert NothingToMigrate();\n        emit OperatorFeeMigrated(identityId, msg.sender, credited);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Spend `amount` of the caller's migration credit into a fresh V10\n    ///         conviction position on `targetNode` at `lockTier`. Repeatable\n    ///         until the credit is spent. Any tier-6/12 allocation receives the\n    ///         conviction lock-credit (universal).\n    function allocate(\n        uint72 targetNode,\n        uint96 amount,\n        uint40 lockTier\n    ) external returns (uint256 tokenId) {\n        if (targetNode == 0) revert InvalidIdentityId();\n        if (amount == 0) revert ZeroAmount();\n        tokenId = ++nextTokenId;\n        // CEI: settle CSS state (credit debit + position) first, mint last.\n        // `_mint` (not `_safeMint`) \u2014 same supported-caller rationale as\n        // `createConviction`.\n        bool creditApplied = stakingV10.allocateFromCredit(msg.sender, tokenId, targetNode, amount, lockTier);\n        _mint(msg.sender, tokenId);\n        emit Allocated(msg.sender, tokenId, targetNode, amount, lockTier, creditApplied);\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Drain `delegator`'s V8 stake across `sourceNodes` into credit,\n    ///      summing the total. A node with no V8 stake contributes 0;\n    ///      idempotent (a re-drained node yields 0).\n    function _drainAll(\n        address delegator,\n        uint72[] calldata sourceNodes\n    ) internal returns (uint96 total) {\n        uint256 n = sourceNodes.length;\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n            // Benign: onlyConvictionNFT callee over trusted storage, plain ERC20,\n            // idempotent (see adminDrainBatch).\n            // slither-disable-next-line calls-loop\n            total += stakingV10.drainV8ToCredit(delegator, sourceNodes[i]);\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Set the V8\u2192V10 conviction lock-credit (seconds). Owner-settable;\n    ///         set it before running the admin sweep. CSS caps it below the\n    ///         tier-6 lock duration so a position's expiry cannot underflow.\n    function setConvictionCreditSeconds(uint40 secondsValue) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        stakingV10.setConvictionCreditSeconds(secondsValue);\n    }\n\n    // ---- Migration credit views (forward to the CSS ledger) ----\n\n    function migrationCredit(address user) external view returns (uint96) {\n        return convictionStakingStorage.migrationCredit(user);\n    }\n\n    function convictionCreditSeconds() external view returns (uint40) {\n        return convictionStakingStorage.convictionCreditSeconds();\n    }\n\n    /// @notice DAO closer \u2014 D11. Sets the `v10LaunchEpoch` marker on\n    ///         `ConvictionStakingStorage` to formally close the V10\n    ///         migration window. After this, late drains are still possible via\n    ///         `adminDrainBatch` / `adminMigrateToCredit`, but the launch-epoch\n    ///         field is the canonical off-chain cut-off for retroactive\n    ///         reward / analytics windows.\n    function finalizeMigrationBatch(uint256 v10LaunchEpoch) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        stakingV10.setV10LaunchEpoch(v10LaunchEpoch);\n        emit MigrationBatchFinalized(v10LaunchEpoch);\n    }\n\n    // ========================================================================\n    // ERC-721 overrides \u2014 accrued-interest transfer model (Phase 5 Q8)\n    // ========================================================================\n    //\n    // Mint/burn/transfer all flow through `_update`. For transfers, we do\n    // NOT settle rewards, reset `lastClaimedEpoch`, or touch the position \u2014\n    // the NFT carries its unclaimed rewards like a bond with accrued\n    // coupon (the accrued-interest NFT transfer model).\n    //\n    // The body is a pure `super._update` pass-through; this explicit\n    // override exists to (a) document the intent and (b) satisfy the\n    // compiler override requirement for `ERC721Enumerable`.\n\n    function supportsInterface(\n        bytes4 interfaceId\n    ) public view virtual override(ERC721Enumerable) returns (bool) {\n        return super.supportsInterface(interfaceId);\n    }\n\n    function _increaseBalance(\n        address account,\n        uint128 value\n    ) internal virtual override(ERC721Enumerable) {\n        super._increaseBalance(account, value);\n    }\n\n    function _update(\n        address to,\n        uint256 tokenId,\n        address auth\n    ) internal virtual override(ERC721Enumerable) returns (address) {\n        return super._update(to, tokenId, auth);\n    }\n}\n","keccak256":"0xe1c2531fb607e85d370a3854f2a993b4548a4db8e1f5ea4a986cf5bcc0d8ccd9","license":"Apache-2.0"},"contracts/Guardian.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\n\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\n\nimport {HubDependent} from \"./abstract/HubDependent.sol\";\nimport {ICustodian} from \"./interfaces/ICustodian.sol\";\nimport {IERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol\";\n\ncontract Guardian is HubDependent {\n    event TokenTransferred(address indexed custodian, uint256 amount);\n    event MisplacedEtherWithdrawn(address indexed custodian, uint256 amount);\n    event MisplacedERC20Withdrawn(address indexed custodian, address tokenContract, uint256 amount);\n\n    error ZeroAddressCustodian();\n    error CustodianNotAContract(address custodian);\n    error CustodianWithoutOwnersFunction(address custodian);\n    error CustodianHasNoOwners(address custodian);\n    error TokenTransferFailed();\n    error EtherTransferFailed();\n    error InvalidTokenContract(address tokenContractAddress);\n\n    IERC20 public tokenContract;\n\n    // solhint-disable-next-line no-empty-blocks\n    constructor(address hubAddress) HubDependent(hubAddress) {}\n\n    function initialize() public virtual onlyHub {\n        tokenContract = IERC20(hub.getContractAddress(\"Token\"));\n    }\n\n    function transferTokens(address payable custodian) external onlyHub {\n        if (custodian == address(0)) {\n            revert ZeroAddressCustodian();\n        }\n\n        uint256 contractSize;\n        assembly {\n            contractSize := extcodesize(custodian)\n        }\n        if (contractSize == 0) {\n            revert CustodianNotAContract(custodian);\n        }\n\n        ICustodian custodianContract = ICustodian(custodian);\n        bool hasOwnersFunction = false;\n        try custodianContract.getOwners() returns (address[] memory owners) {\n            hasOwnersFunction = true;\n            if (owners.length == 0) {\n                revert CustodianHasNoOwners(custodian);\n            }\n        } catch {\n            // getOwners reverted (e.g. not ICustodian); hasOwnersFunction stays false.\n        }\n        if (!hasOwnersFunction) {\n            revert CustodianWithoutOwnersFunction(custodian);\n        }\n\n        uint256 balanceTransferred = tokenContract.balanceOf(address(this));\n        bool transactionResult = tokenContract.transfer(custodian, balanceTransferred);\n\n        if (!transactionResult) {\n            revert TokenTransferFailed();\n        }\n\n        emit TokenTransferred(custodian, balanceTransferred);\n    }\n\n    function withdrawMisplacedEther() external onlyHub {\n        uint256 balance = address(this).balance;\n        if (balance > 0) {\n            (bool success, ) = msg.sender.call{value: balance}(\"\");\n            if (!success) {\n                revert EtherTransferFailed();\n            }\n        }\n        emit MisplacedEtherWithdrawn(msg.sender, balance);\n    }\n\n    function withdrawMisplacedTokens(address tokenContractAddress) external onlyHub {\n        if (tokenContractAddress == address(tokenContract)) {\n            revert InvalidTokenContract(tokenContractAddress);\n        }\n        IERC20 misplacedTokensContract = IERC20(tokenContractAddress);\n\n        uint256 balance = misplacedTokensContract.balanceOf(address(this));\n        if (balance > 0) {\n            bool transactionResult = misplacedTokensContract.transfer(msg.sender, balance);\n            if (!transactionResult) {\n                revert TokenTransferFailed();\n            }\n        }\n        emit MisplacedERC20Withdrawn(msg.sender, tokenContractAddress, balance);\n    }\n}\n","keccak256":"0x9b0a19e3128c41dfdf8bd8b4ad9f9d04e1636053b547892c1cb1874ae56cc5a3","license":"Apache-2.0"},"contracts/ShardingTable.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\n\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\n\nimport {ProfileStorage} from \"./storage/ProfileStorage.sol\";\nimport {ShardingTableStorage} from \"./storage/ShardingTableStorage.sol\";\nimport {ConvictionStakingStorage} from \"./storage/ConvictionStakingStorage.sol\";\nimport {ParametersStorage} from \"./storage/ParametersStorage.sol\";\nimport {ContractStatus} from \"./abstract/ContractStatus.sol\";\nimport {IInitializable} from \"./interfaces/IInitializable.sol\";\nimport {INamed} from \"./interfaces/INamed.sol\";\nimport {IVersioned} from \"./interfaces/IVersioned.sol\";\nimport {ShardingTableLib} from \"./libraries/ShardingTableLib.sol\";\n\ncontract ShardingTable is INamed, IVersioned, ContractStatus, IInitializable {\n    string private constant _NAME = \"ShardingTable\";\n    // v2.0.0 \u2014 ABI-breaking: dropped the V8\u2192V9 `migrationPeriodEnd` field\n    // and its constructor parameter, plus the matching public getter.\n    // Original purpose: gate the `migrateOldShardingTable` Neuroweb-only\n    // function set during the old ShardingTable migration window. That\n    // function was removed during the V9\u2192V10 consolidation, leaving the\n    // field as dead state on a Logic contract \u2014 a violation of the\n    // Storage/Logic separation pattern. The Neuroweb-only branch in\n    // `019_deploy_sharding_table.ts` that referenced `migrateOldShardingTable`\n    // is removed in the same PR (the function it called no longer exists,\n    // so the branch was already unreachable on V10 deploys).\n    string private constant _VERSION = \"10.0.3\";\n\n    ProfileStorage public profileStorage;\n    ShardingTableStorage public shardingTableStorage;\n    /// @notice v4.0.0 \u2014 V10 canonical node stake source. Replaces the prior\n    ///         `stakingStorage` reference; the V8 archive is unmaintained\n    ///         post-migration so its `getNodeStake` is not a faithful read.\n    ConvictionStakingStorage public convictionStakingStorage;\n\n    /// @notice The sharding table is full: `nodesCount` has reached the\n    ///         governance-configured `shardingTableSizeLimit`. The cap bounds\n    ///         the O(n) re-index loops in `insertNode`/`removeNode` so they\n    ///         cannot exceed the block gas limit.\n    error ShardingTableIsFull(uint72 nodesCount, uint16 sizeLimit);\n\n    // solhint-disable-next-line no-empty-blocks\n    constructor(address hubAddress) ContractStatus(hubAddress) {}\n\n    function initialize() public onlyHub {\n        profileStorage = ProfileStorage(hub.getContractAddress(\"ProfileStorage\"));\n        shardingTableStorage = ShardingTableStorage(hub.getContractAddress(\"ShardingTableStorage\"));\n        convictionStakingStorage = ConvictionStakingStorage(hub.getContractAddress(\"ConvictionStakingStorage\"));\n    }\n\n    function name() external pure virtual override returns (string memory) {\n        return _NAME;\n    }\n\n    function version() external pure virtual override returns (string memory) {\n        return _VERSION;\n    }\n\n    function getShardingTable(\n        uint72 startingIdentityId,\n        uint72 nodesNumber\n    ) external view returns (ShardingTableLib.NodeInfo[] memory) {\n        return _getShardingTable(startingIdentityId, nodesNumber);\n    }\n\n    function getShardingTable() external view returns (ShardingTableLib.NodeInfo[] memory) {\n        ShardingTableStorage sts = shardingTableStorage;\n        return _getShardingTable(sts.indexToIdentityId(0), sts.nodesCount());\n    }\n\n    function insertNode(uint72 identityId) external onlyContracts {\n        uint256 newNodeHashRingPosition = uint256(sha256(profileStorage.getNodeId(identityId)));\n\n        _insertNode(_binarySearchForIndex(newNodeHashRingPosition), identityId, newNodeHashRingPosition);\n    }\n\n    function insertNode(uint72 index, uint72 identityId) external onlyContracts {\n        _insertNode(index, identityId, uint256(sha256(profileStorage.getNodeId(identityId))));\n    }\n\n    function removeNode(uint72 identityId) external onlyContracts {\n        ShardingTableStorage sts = shardingTableStorage;\n\n        ShardingTableLib.Node memory nodeToRemove = sts.getNode(identityId);\n\n        // Decrement indexes of all nodes after removed one + add pointers to identityId for changed indexes\n        uint72 index = nodeToRemove.index;\n        uint72 nextIdentityId = sts.indexToIdentityId(nodeToRemove.index + 1);\n        while (nextIdentityId != ShardingTableLib.NULL) {\n            sts.decrementNodeIndex(nextIdentityId);\n            sts.setIdentityId(index, nextIdentityId);\n\n            unchecked {\n                index += 1;\n            }\n\n            nextIdentityId = sts.indexToIdentityId(index + 1);\n        }\n\n        // Delete node object + set last index pointer to be ShardingTableLib.NULL + decrement total nodes count\n        sts.deleteNodeObject(identityId);\n        sts.setIdentityId(index, ShardingTableLib.NULL);\n        sts.decrementNodesCount();\n    }\n\n    function _binarySearchForIndex(uint256 hashRingPosition) internal virtual returns (uint72) {\n        ShardingTableStorage sts = shardingTableStorage;\n\n        uint72 nodesCount = sts.nodesCount();\n\n        if (nodesCount == 0) {\n            return 0;\n        }\n\n        uint72 left;\n        uint72 mid;\n        uint72 right = nodesCount - 1;\n\n        while (left <= right) {\n            mid = (left + right) / 2;\n            uint256 currentHashRingPosition = sts.getHashRingPositionByIndex(mid);\n\n            if (hashRingPosition > currentHashRingPosition) {\n                // Node is in the right half of the range, move left pointers\n                left = mid + 1;\n            } else if (hashRingPosition < currentHashRingPosition) {\n                if (mid == 0) {\n                    // The new element should be inserted at index 0\n                    return 0;\n                }\n                // Node is in the left half of the range, move right pointers\n                right = mid - 1;\n            } else {\n                // Exact match found\n                return mid;\n            }\n        }\n\n        return left;\n    }\n\n    function _insertNode(uint72 index, uint72 identityId, uint256 newNodeHashRingPosition) internal virtual {\n        ShardingTableStorage sts = shardingTableStorage;\n        ProfileStorage ps = profileStorage;\n\n        // SECURITY FIX: enforce the configured size cap. `shardingTableSizeLimit`\n        // (default 500) had a setter but was checked at NO insert site, so the\n        // table could grow without bound \u2014 making the O(n) re-index loops in\n        // insertNode/removeNode (both walk every node after the touched index)\n        // exceed the block gas limit, which freezes unstake/redelegate/leave\n        // and any other op that re-indexes the table. ParametersStorage is\n        // resolved from the Hub at call time (it is deployed AFTER ShardingTable,\n        // so it cannot be cached in initialize() without breaking deployment).\n        uint72 nodesCount = sts.nodesCount();\n        uint16 sizeLimit = ParametersStorage(hub.getContractAddress(\"ParametersStorage\")).shardingTableSizeLimit();\n        if (nodesCount >= sizeLimit) {\n            revert ShardingTableIsFull(nodesCount, sizeLimit);\n        }\n\n        if (sts.nodeExists(identityId)) {\n            revert ShardingTableLib.NodeAlreadyInTheShardingTable(identityId);\n        }\n\n        if (index != 0) {\n            uint256 prevNodeHashRingPosition = sts.getHashRingPositionByIndex(index - 1);\n\n            // Check that the new Node is indeed on the right from the prevNode\n            // Also allows new Head insertion as prevNode.hashRingPosition will be 0 in such case\n            if (newNodeHashRingPosition < prevNodeHashRingPosition) {\n                revert ShardingTableLib.InvalidIndexWithRespectToPreviousNode(\n                    identityId,\n                    newNodeHashRingPosition,\n                    prevNodeHashRingPosition\n                );\n            }\n        }\n\n        ShardingTableLib.Node memory nextNode = sts.getNodeByIndex(index);\n\n        // Check that the new Node is indeed on the left from the nextNode\n        // Check is skipped when inserting new Tail\n        if (nextNode.identityId != ShardingTableLib.NULL && newNodeHashRingPosition > nextNode.hashRingPosition) {\n            revert ShardingTableLib.InvalidIndexWithRespectToNextNode(\n                identityId,\n                newNodeHashRingPosition,\n                nextNode.hashRingPosition\n            );\n        }\n        // Create node object + set index pointer to new identityId + increment total nodes count\n        sts.createNodeObject(newNodeHashRingPosition, ps.getNodeId(identityId), identityId, index);\n        sts.setIdentityId(index, identityId);\n        sts.incrementNodesCount();\n\n        // Increment indexes of all nodes after inserted one + add pointers to identityId for changed indexes\n        uint72 currentIdentityId;\n        uint72 nextIdentityId = nextNode.identityId;\n        while (nextIdentityId != ShardingTableLib.NULL) {\n            unchecked {\n                index += 1;\n            }\n\n            currentIdentityId = nextIdentityId;\n            nextIdentityId = sts.indexToIdentityId(index);\n\n            sts.incrementNodeIndex(currentIdentityId);\n            sts.setIdentityId(index, currentIdentityId);\n        }\n    }\n\n    function _getShardingTable(\n        uint72 startingIdentityId,\n        uint72 nodesNumber\n    ) internal view virtual returns (ShardingTableLib.NodeInfo[] memory) {\n        ShardingTableLib.NodeInfo[] memory nodesPage;\n        ShardingTableStorage sts = shardingTableStorage;\n\n        if ((sts.nodesCount() == 0) || (nodesNumber == 0)) {\n            return nodesPage;\n        }\n        ShardingTableLib.Node memory startingNode = sts.getNode(startingIdentityId);\n\n        if (startingIdentityId == ShardingTableLib.NULL || startingNode.identityId == ShardingTableLib.NULL) {\n            revert ShardingTableLib.InvalidStartingIdentityId(startingIdentityId);\n        }\n\n        nodesPage = new ShardingTableLib.NodeInfo[](nodesNumber);\n\n        ProfileStorage ps = profileStorage;\n        ConvictionStakingStorage cs = convictionStakingStorage;\n\n        uint72 nextIdentityId = startingIdentityId;\n        uint72 index;\n        while ((index < nodesNumber) && (nextIdentityId != ShardingTableLib.NULL)) {\n            // v4.0.0 \u2014 V10 canonical node stake. Down-cast to uint96 is safe\n            // under protocol invariants: `StakingV10.stake` enforces\n            // `nodeStakeV10 <= parametersStorage.maximumStake()` (uint96), and\n            // the V10 raw stake field cannot exceed the cap.\n            uint256 stake256 = cs.getNodeStakeV10(nextIdentityId);\n            uint96 stakeView = stake256 > type(uint96).max ? type(uint96).max : uint96(stake256);\n            nodesPage[index] = ShardingTableLib.NodeInfo({\n                nodeId: ps.getNodeId(nextIdentityId),\n                identityId: nextIdentityId,\n                ask: ps.getAsk(nextIdentityId),\n                stake: stakeView\n            });\n\n            unchecked {\n                index += 1;\n            }\n            nextIdentityId = sts.indexToIdentityId(index + startingNode.index);\n        }\n\n        return nodesPage;\n    }\n}\n","keccak256":"0xcf2c1f83e5c49a0a63995e5812ee78fa1de35c22dcb0fbf31a14ec9890ae270f","license":"Apache-2.0"},"contracts/StakingV10.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\n\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\n\nimport {ShardingTable} from \"./ShardingTable.sol\";\nimport {Ask} from \"./Ask.sol\";\nimport {ParametersStorage} from \"./storage/ParametersStorage.sol\";\nimport {ProfileStorage} from \"./storage/ProfileStorage.sol\";\nimport {ShardingTableStorage} from \"./storage/ShardingTableStorage.sol\";\nimport {StakingStorage} from \"./storage/StakingStorage.sol\";\nimport {ConvictionStakingStorage} from \"./storage/ConvictionStakingStorage.sol\";\nimport {IdentityStorage} from \"./storage/IdentityStorage.sol\";\nimport {RandomSamplingStorage} from \"./storage/RandomSamplingStorage.sol\";\nimport {EpochStorage} from \"./storage/EpochStorage.sol\";\nimport {Chronos} from \"./storage/Chronos.sol\";\nimport {ContractStatus} from \"./abstract/ContractStatus.sol\";\nimport {IInitializable} from \"./interfaces/IInitializable.sol\";\nimport {INamed} from \"./interfaces/INamed.sol\";\nimport {IVersioned} from \"./interfaces/IVersioned.sol\";\nimport {IdentityLib} from \"./libraries/IdentityLib.sol\";\nimport {Permissions} from \"./libraries/Permissions.sol\";\nimport {StakingLib} from \"./libraries/StakingLib.sol\";\nimport {TokenLib} from \"./libraries/TokenLib.sol\";\nimport {IERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol\";\nimport {SafeERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/utils/SafeERC20.sol\";\n\n/**\n * @title StakingV10\n * @notice V10 NFT-backed staking orchestrator. Canonical staking entry point\n *         post-migration.\n *\n * V10 architecture (post-consolidation, v3.0.0 / CSS v4.0.0):\n *   - All V10 delegator state, the TRAC vault, AND operator-fee accounting\n *     live in `ConvictionStakingStorage` (CSS). CSS extends `Guardian`, holds\n *     `tokenContract`, and exposes `transferStake` for outflows. Deposits\n *     route TRAC into the CSS address; withdrawals call `cs.transferStake`.\n *   - `StakingStorage` is dead weight in the V10 hot path. It is read ONLY\n *     by `_convertToNFT` (V8\u2192V10 drain at cutover). Operator-fee balances,\n *     operator-fee withdrawal requests, and the TRAC vault role moved into\n *     CSS in v4.0.0.\n *   - DelegatorsInfo is unregistered (D13). The two per-node-per-epoch\n *     flags it used to hold (`isOperatorFeeClaimedForEpoch`,\n *     `netNodeEpochRewards`) were absorbed into ConvictionStakingStorage.\n *   - The V8 Staking contract is unregistered. The V8-side score\n *     settlement helper (`Staking.prepareForStakeChange`) is no longer\n *     reachable from V10 (D17); the V10-native `_prepareForStakeChangeV10`\n *     handles all V10 settlement. Operator-fee request/finalize/cancel\n *     was V8-only \u2014 v3.0.0 ports it to V10 (CSS-backed) so post-consolidation\n *     deploys can fully drain operator fees without the V8 contract.\n *\n * Rewards model (D19 \u2014 compound into raw):\n *   - `claim()` walks the unclaimed window, sums TRAC rewards, and compounds\n *     them directly into the position's `raw` via `cs.increaseRaw`. The\n *     compounded TRAC therefore earns the position's current multiplier\n *     going forward. A parallel statistic-only counter\n *     `cs.cumulativeRewardsClaimed` tracks lifetime reward compounding for\n *     UI/indexer consumption.\n *   - There is no separate `rewards` bucket, no `increaseRewards` /\n *     `decreaseRewards`.\n *\n * Withdraw model (D14 \u2014 atomic):\n *   - `withdraw()` is a single transaction. Pre-expiry is disallowed (lock\n *     still active). Post-expiry (or tier-0 rest state) it auto-claims any\n *     outstanding rewards into `raw`, pays out the full `raw` balance from\n *     the `StakingStorage` TRAC vault to the owner, and deletes the CSS\n *     position. The NFT wrapper burns the token on the back half. There is\n *     no request/cancel/finalize dance and no address-timer delay \u2014 the\n *     lock IS the delay, and partial withdrawals are not a first-class\n *     feature (re-stake the remainder for the same economic result).\n *\n * Redelegate model (D25 \u2014 in-place):\n *   - `redelegate()` is a single transaction that mutates `pos.identityId`\n *     in place on CSS via `updateOnRedelegate`. Same tokenId, same\n *     `expiryEpoch`, same rewards cursor \u2014 only the node assignment\n *     changes. `relock` continues to use the D21/D23 burn-and-mint path\n *     because relock materially changes tier / multiplier / expiry.\n */\ncontract StakingV10 is INamed, IVersioned, ContractStatus, IInitializable {\n    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;\n\n    // ========================================================================\n    // Metadata\n    // ========================================================================\n\n    string private constant _NAME = \"StakingV10\";\n    // Version history:\n    //   2.0.0 \u2014 initial V10 orchestrator (post-migration).\n    //   2.1.0 \u2014 atomic `withdraw` + in-place `redelegate`.\n    //   2.2.0 \u2014 aligned with CSS v2.2.0: `PendingWithdrawal` storage gone,\n    //           `redelegate` goes through `updateOnRedelegate` (tokenId +\n    //           expiryEpoch preserved), `withdraw` is a single-tx exit\n    //           with auto-claim.\n    //   2.3.0 \u2014 D26 code-review follow-ups:\n    //           * H1 \u2014 `_claim` dormancy bomb fixed: rewardless epochs\n    //             early-continue (no fee-flag SSTORE, no per-epoch SLOAD\n    //             storm).\n    //           * H2 \u2014 expiry-split reward math extracted into a shared\n    //             `_delegatorIncrementForEpoch` helper; `_claim` and\n    //             `_prepareForStakeChangeV10` share one code path.\n    //           * L3 \u2014 `lockTier` widened from `uint8` to `uint40` across\n    //             the public surface so admins can add tier ids above 255.\n    //           * L11 \u2014 `createPosition` no longer takes `multiplier18`;\n    //             CSS reads it from the tier table.\n    //   3.0.0 \u2014 Storage consolidation (CSS v4.0.0):\n    //           * `stake` deposits TRAC into `convictionStorage` (CSS) instead\n    //             of `stakingStorage` (SS). CSS extends Guardian and is the\n    //             V10 TRAC vault.\n    //           * `withdraw` outflow uses `convictionStorage.transferStake`.\n    //           * `_claim` operator-fee accrual writes to\n    //             `convictionStorage.increaseOperatorFeeBalance`.\n    //           * NEW: `requestOperatorFeeWithdrawal`,\n    //             `finalizeOperatorFeeWithdrawal`, `cancelOperatorFeeWithdrawal`\n    //             \u2014 V10-native operator-fee withdrawal API (was V8-only). Uses\n    //             `parametersStorage.stakeWithdrawalDelay` cooldown.\n    //           * `stakingStorage` is retained ONLY for `_convertToNFT`'s\n    //             V8\u2192V10 drain at cutover.\n    //   3.1.0 \u2014 V8\u2192V10 migration conviction credit (CSS v4.1.0):\n    //           * `allocateFromCredit`, for migrants picking lockTier 6 or 12,\n    //             shortens the V10 NFT's default `expiryTimestamp` by\n    //             `convictionCreditSeconds` (universal \u2014 no eligibility\n    //             registry; every 6/12 migration allocation earns it).\n    //           * `convictionStorage.createPosition(...)` calls now pass the\n    //             new `expiryShortenedBy` arg (CSS v4.1.0). `stake` always\n    //             passes 0; `_convertToNFT` passes 0 except for eligible\n    //             6m/12m migrants.\n    //   10.0.3 \u2014 Audit fix: mid-epoch `redelegate`/`relock` orphaned the\n    //           current epoch's settled delegator score (the old\n    //           (epoch, node, key) RSS slot was never read again after the\n    //           identity flip / tokenId re-key).\n    //           * `redelegate` / `relock` record a `RewardCarry` pointer in\n    //             CSS when the settled score is non-zero.\n    //           * `_claim` integrates matured carries (epoch closed) via the\n    //             extracted `_nodeEpochReward` helper, then clears them.\n    //   10.0.5 \u2014 Permissionless claim WITHOUT a wrapper redeploy: adds the\n    //           public `claimFor(tokenId)` settlement entry point (anyone may\n    //           trigger; rewards compound to the tokenId-keyed NFT owner). The\n    //           `onlyConvictionNFT` `claim` keeps its 2-arg `(staker, tokenId)`\n    //           signature so the deployed 10.0.3 wrapper still works post-\n    //           redeploy \u2014 superseding #1302's wrapper-side change, which could\n    //           not ship to mainnet without orphaning existing position NFTs.\n    //           Also carries the #1297 boost-expiry reward-boundary fix (which\n    //           had landed under the unchanged 10.0.4 string).\n    string private constant _VERSION = \"10.0.5\";\n\n    /// @notice Emitted when a node crosses `minimumStake` during a\n    /// stake / redelegate / claim but the sharding table is full, so its\n    /// admission is deferred. Admission is best-effort housekeeping: the node\n    /// stays out of the ring (earning no score, which is correct) and is\n    /// re-attempted on the next stake/claim once a slot frees. The caller's\n    /// stake / claim / withdraw / redelegate is never blocked by a full table. #1286\n    event NodeAdmissionDeferred(uint72 indexed identityId, uint256 nodeStakeV10);\n\n    // ========================================================================\n    // Constants\n    // ========================================================================\n\n    /// @notice 1e18 fixed-point scale shared with `ConvictionStakingStorage`.\n    uint256 public constant SCALE18 = 1e18;\n\n    /// @notice EpochStorage shard ID for the reward pool.\n    uint256 private constant EPOCH_POOL_INDEX = 1;\n\n    // ========================================================================\n    // Hub-wired dependencies\n    // ========================================================================\n\n    /// @notice V8 archive accessor \u2014 present ONLY for `_convertToNFT`'s V8\u2192V10\n    ///         drain. The V10 hot path (stake/withdraw/claim/operator-fee\n    ///         accrual + withdrawal) reads and writes `convictionStorage`\n    ///         exclusively (v4.0.0 consolidation).\n    StakingStorage public stakingStorage;\n    ConvictionStakingStorage public convictionStorage;\n    Chronos public chronos;\n    RandomSamplingStorage public randomSamplingStorage;\n    ShardingTableStorage public shardingTableStorage;\n    ShardingTable public shardingTable;\n    Ask public ask;\n    ParametersStorage public parametersStorage;\n    ProfileStorage public profileStorage;\n    /// @notice IdentityStorage for `onlyAdmin(identityId)` admin-key checks\n    ///         (operator-fee withdrawal request / finalize / cancel).\n    IdentityStorage public identityStorage;\n    IERC20 public token;\n    EpochStorage public epochStorage;\n\n    // ========================================================================\n    // Events\n    // ========================================================================\n\n    event Staked(\n        uint256 indexed tokenId,\n        address indexed staker,\n        uint72 indexed identityId,\n        uint96 amount,\n        uint40 lockTier\n    );\n    event Relocked(uint256 indexed tokenId, uint40 newLockTier, uint64 newExpiryTimestamp);\n    event Redelegated(uint256 indexed tokenId, uint72 indexed oldIdentityId, uint72 indexed newIdentityId);\n    /// @notice Authoritative atomic-withdraw event. `amount` is the total\n    ///         TRAC paid out to `staker` (post-auto-claim `raw`). The NFT\n    ///         wrapper burns `tokenId` on the back half.\n    event Withdrawn(uint256 indexed tokenId, address indexed staker, uint96 amount);\n    event RewardsClaimed(uint256 indexed tokenId, uint96 amount);\n\n    // ========================================================================\n    // Errors\n    // ========================================================================\n\n    error InvalidLockTier();\n    error LockStillActive();\n    error NotPositionOwner();\n    error ZeroAmount();\n    error MaxStakeExceeded();\n    error SameIdentity();\n    error ProfileDoesNotExist();\n    error RewardOverflow();\n    error PositionNotFound();\n    error UnclaimedEpochs();\n    error V8StakingStillLive();\n    error NodeAlreadyInShardingTable(uint72 identityId);\n    error NodeBelowMinimumStake(uint72 identityId);\n\n    // ========================================================================\n    // Constructor + initialize\n    // ========================================================================\n\n    // solhint-disable-next-line no-empty-blocks\n    constructor(address hubAddress) ContractStatus(hubAddress) {}\n\n    /**\n     * @dev Wires Hub-registered dependencies. DelegatorsInfo and the V8\n     *      `Staking` contract are NOT looked up here (D3 + D17 + D13):\n     *      DelegatorsInfo is unregistered by deploy script 021, V8 Staking\n     *      is unregistered by deploy script 998 as part of the migration\n     *      cutover.\n     */\n    function initialize() external onlyHub {\n        stakingStorage = StakingStorage(hub.getContractAddress(\"StakingStorage\"));\n        convictionStorage = ConvictionStakingStorage(hub.getContractAddress(\"ConvictionStakingStorage\"));\n        chronos = Chronos(hub.getContractAddress(\"Chronos\"));\n        randomSamplingStorage = RandomSamplingStorage(hub.getContractAddress(\"RandomSamplingStorage\"));\n        shardingTableStorage = ShardingTableStorage(hub.getContractAddress(\"ShardingTableStorage\"));\n        shardingTable = ShardingTable(hub.getContractAddress(\"ShardingTable\"));\n        ask = Ask(hub.getContractAddress(\"Ask\"));\n        parametersStorage = ParametersStorage(hub.getContractAddress(\"ParametersStorage\"));\n        profileStorage = ProfileStorage(hub.getContractAddress(\"ProfileStorage\"));\n        identityStorage = IdentityStorage(hub.getContractAddress(\"IdentityStorage\"));\n        token = IERC20(hub.getContractAddress(\"Token\"));\n        epochStorage = EpochStorage(hub.getContractAddress(\"EpochStorageV8\"));\n    }\n\n    function name() external pure virtual override returns (string memory) {\n        return _NAME;\n    }\n\n    function version() external pure virtual override returns (string memory) {\n        return _VERSION;\n    }\n\n    // ========================================================================\n    // Caller gate\n    // ========================================================================\n\n    modifier onlyConvictionNFT() {\n        if (msg.sender != hub.getContractAddress(\"DKGStakingConvictionNFT\")) {\n            revert StakingLib.OnlyConvictionNFT();\n        }\n        _;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Operator-fee admin gate. Mirrors V8 `Staking.onlyAdmin` \u2014\n    ///         the caller's address (hashed) must hold ADMIN_KEY purpose\n    ///         on `identityId` per `IdentityStorage`.\n    modifier onlyAdmin(uint72 identityId) {\n        if (\n            !identityStorage.keyHasPurpose(\n                identityId,\n                keccak256(abi.encodePacked(msg.sender)),\n                IdentityLib.ADMIN_KEY\n            )\n        ) {\n            revert Permissions.OnlyProfileAdminFunction(msg.sender);\n        }\n        _;\n    }\n\n    // ========================================================================\n    // Internal guards\n    // ========================================================================\n\n    /**\n     * @dev Reverts `UnclaimedEpochs` if the position has not been claimed up\n     *      to `currentEpoch - 1`.  Called at the top of every stake-changing\n     *      entry point so that reward history is settled before any\n     *      structural mutation. NOT called in `stake` (no prior position) or\n     *      `convertToNFT` (the V10 position is being seeded fresh; the V8-\n     *      side rolling rewards no longer gate migration per D7/D8).\n     */\n    function _requireFullyClaimed(ConvictionStakingStorage.Position memory pos) internal view {\n        uint256 currentEpoch = chronos.getCurrentEpoch();\n        if (currentEpoch <= 1) return;\n        if (uint256(pos.lastClaimedEpoch) < currentEpoch - 1) revert UnclaimedEpochs();\n    }\n\n    // ========================================================================\n    // External entry points\n    // ========================================================================\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Mint a fresh NFT-backed staking position on `identityId` with\n     *         `amount` TRAC locked for `lockTier` epochs.\n     *\n     * @dev V10 flow (D15 \u2014 CSS-only accounting):\n     *        1. Amount + tier validation.\n     *        2. Destination profile existence.\n     *        3. maxStake cap on the DESTINATION V10 node stake\n     *           (`cs.nodeStakeV10`, NOT `ss.nodeStake`). StakingStorage's\n     *           node stake is V8 legacy and stale post-migration.\n     *        4. V10 settlement baseline (zero stake, bumps the\n     *           node-epoch-score-per-stake cursor for this token).\n     *        5. TRAC transfer into the StakingStorage vault (still the\n     *           protocol-wide TRAC custody).\n     *        6. CSS position creation (migrationEpoch = 0 \u2014 fresh stake).\n     *        7. Sharding-table insert threshold, Ask recalc.\n     */\n    function stake(\n        address staker,\n        uint256 tokenId,\n        uint72 identityId,\n        uint96 amount,\n        uint40 lockTier\n    ) external onlyConvictionNFT {\n        if (amount == 0) revert ZeroAmount();\n        if (!profileStorage.profileExists(identityId)) revert ProfileDoesNotExist();\n\n        // Tier-existence / activeness is checked by CSS.createPosition.\n\n        uint256 maxStake = uint256(parametersStorage.maximumStake());\n        uint256 totalNodeStakeAfter = convictionStorage.getNodeStakeV10(identityId) + uint256(amount);\n        if (totalNodeStakeAfter > maxStake) revert MaxStakeExceeded();\n\n        if (token.allowance(staker, address(this)) < amount) {\n            revert TokenLib.TooLowAllowance(address(token), token.allowance(staker, address(this)), amount);\n        }\n\n        if (token.balanceOf(staker) < amount) {\n            revert TokenLib.TooLowBalance(address(token), token.balanceOf(staker), amount);\n        }\n\n        _prepareForStakeChangeV10(chronos.getCurrentEpoch(), tokenId, identityId);\n\n        // v4.0.0 \u2014 TRAC flows into the CSS vault. CSS extends Guardian and\n        // exposes `transferStake` for the withdraw outflow side. The NFT\n        // wrapper never holds funds; the V8 StakingStorage is no longer in\n        // the deposit path.\n        //\n        // Slither flags this site twice:\n        //   - `arbitrary-send-erc20`: `staker` is the `from` argument. NOT\n        //     arbitrary \u2014 the `onlyConvictionNFT` modifier restricts callers\n        //     to the convictionNFT contract, which only invokes `stake()`\n        //     for the NFT holder whose token is being created. The allowance\n        //     check at line 340 above proves the `staker` authorised this\n        //     specific transfer (or the call reverts before reaching here).\n        //   - `unchecked-transfer`: `safeTransferFrom` (SafeERC20) reverts\n        //     on failure; the false-return path Slither warns about does\n        //     not apply.\n        // slither-disable-next-line arbitrary-send-erc20,unchecked-transfer\n        token.safeTransferFrom(staker, address(convictionStorage), amount);\n\n        // L11 \u2014 multiplier18 is no longer passed in; CSS reads it from the\n        //       tier table (single source of truth).\n        // v4.1.0 \u2014 fresh V10 stakes never receive the V8 migration credit;\n        //          `expiryShortenedBy` is therefore always 0 here.\n        convictionStorage.createPosition(\n            tokenId,\n            identityId,\n            amount,\n            lockTier,\n            0, // fresh V10 stake: no migrationEpoch\n            0 // fresh V10 stake: no expiry credit\n        );\n\n        // Sharding-table maintenance gates on the V10 canonical node stake.\n        ParametersStorage ps = parametersStorage;\n        ShardingTableStorage sts = shardingTableStorage;\n        if (!sts.nodeExists(identityId) && totalNodeStakeAfter >= uint256(ps.minimumStake())) {\n            _tryAdmitNode(identityId);\n        }\n\n        ask.recalculateActiveSet();\n\n        emit Staked(tokenId, staker, identityId, amount, lockTier);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Post-expiry re-commit of an existing position to a new lock\n     *         tier. Raw stake unchanged; multiplier + expiry shift. Under\n     *         D21 this is a burn-and-mint: `oldTokenId` is burned by the\n     *         NFT wrapper, `newTokenId` is a freshly-minted NFT the wrapper\n     *         has already allocated, and the on-chain position state moves\n     *         over via the D23 `createNewPositionFromExisting` primitive.\n     *\n     * @dev Continuity preserved across the burn-mint:\n     *        - `raw` (principal unchanged \u2014 no TRAC moves).\n     *        - `cumulativeRewardsClaimed` (lifetime reward stat).\n     *        - `lastClaimedEpoch` (reward cursor \u2014 prevents double-claim).\n     *        - `migrationEpoch` (D6 retroactive-claim marker).\n     *      Re-initialized on the new tokenId:\n     *        - `lockTier`, `multiplier18`, `expiryEpoch` (the whole point\n     *          of relock).\n     *      `identityId` is held constant \u2014 this is relock, not redelegate.\n     */\n    function relock(\n        address staker,\n        uint256 oldTokenId,\n        uint256 newTokenId,\n        uint40 newLockTier\n    ) external onlyConvictionNFT {\n        staker; // unused \u2014 see file-header rationale.\n\n        ConvictionStakingStorage.Position memory pos = convictionStorage.getPosition(oldTokenId);\n        if (pos.identityId == 0) revert PositionNotFound();\n        _requireFullyClaimed(pos);\n\n        // D26 \u2014 timestamp-accurate lock gate. Tier-0 (expiryTimestamp == 0)\n        // is already in rest state; any non-zero expiry must have elapsed.\n        if (pos.expiryTimestamp != 0 && block.timestamp < uint256(pos.expiryTimestamp)) revert LockStillActive();\n\n        uint256 currentEpoch = chronos.getCurrentEpoch();\n        uint256 settledEpochScore18 = _prepareForStakeChangeV10(currentEpoch, oldTokenId, pos.identityId);\n\n        // v10.0.3 \u2014 baseline the NEW tokenId's settlement cursor at the\n        // current score-per-stake BEFORE the position exists under it\n        // (cursor-bump-only branch: `positions[newTokenId].identityId == 0`).\n        // Without this the new key re-integrates the epoch's score from 0\n        // at the NEW multiplier \u2014 over-crediting the delegator and\n        // overdrawing the node's epoch pool. Mirrors the `stake` baseline.\n        _prepareForStakeChangeV10(currentEpoch, newTokenId, pos.identityId);\n\n        // M1 + L11 \u2014 same-identity relock. CSS reads the multiplier from the\n        //            tier table; no need to pass it in. Migrates any existing\n        //            reward carries from oldTokenId to newTokenId (v10.0.3).\n        convictionStorage.createNewPositionFromExisting(\n            oldTokenId,\n            newTokenId,\n            pos.identityId,\n            newLockTier\n        );\n\n        // v10.0.3 \u2014 the score settled this epoch lives in RSS under the OLD\n        // tokenId's delegator key, which `_claim(newTokenId)` would never\n        // read. Carry the pointer across the burn-mint.\n        if (settledEpochScore18 > 0) {\n            convictionStorage.addRewardCarry(\n                newTokenId,\n                pos.identityId,\n                uint32(currentEpoch),\n                bytes32(oldTokenId)\n            );\n        }\n\n        ConvictionStakingStorage.Position memory posAfter = convictionStorage.getPosition(newTokenId);\n        emit Relocked(newTokenId, newLockTier, uint64(posAfter.expiryTimestamp));\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Move a position from its current node to `newIdentityId`.\n     *         Same tokenId persists; only `pos.identityId` mutates.\n     *         Per-node raw / effective stake moves across at `currentEpoch`;\n     *         global totals invariant.\n     *\n     * @dev D25 \u2014 in-place redelegate. The tokenId, `expiryEpoch`,\n     *      `lockTier`, `multiplier18`, `lastClaimedEpoch`, `migrationEpoch`\n     *      and `cumulativeRewardsClaimed` are ALL preserved. The lock\n     *      clock does NOT reset: a redelegation is a routing decision,\n     *      not a new commitment. CSS's `updateOnRedelegate` moves the\n     *      per-node effective-stake contribution at `currentEpoch` and\n     *      reassigns the pending expiry drop from the old node to the\n     *      new node at the same `expiryEpoch`.\n     *\n     *      Fresh stakes still gate on the destination's `maxStake` \u2014\n     *      redelegating INTO a near-capped node can still revert. The\n     *      min-stake boundary on the OLD node may trigger a sharding-\n     *      table removal; the new node may cross back in. Ask recalc\n     *      runs once at the end.\n     */\n    function redelegate(\n        address staker,\n        uint256 tokenId,\n        uint72 newIdentityId\n    ) external onlyConvictionNFT {\n        staker;\n\n        ConvictionStakingStorage.Position memory pos = convictionStorage.getPosition(tokenId);\n        if (pos.identityId == 0) revert PositionNotFound();\n        _requireFullyClaimed(pos);\n        uint72 oldIdentityId = pos.identityId;\n\n        if (oldIdentityId == newIdentityId) revert SameIdentity();\n        if (!profileStorage.profileExists(newIdentityId)) revert ProfileDoesNotExist();\n\n        uint96 raw = pos.raw;\n        require(raw > 0, \"No raw\");\n\n        // Destination maxStake cap gates on V10 canonical node stake.\n        uint256 newNodeStakeAfter = convictionStorage.getNodeStakeV10(newIdentityId) + uint256(raw);\n        uint256 maxStake = uint256(parametersStorage.maximumStake());\n        if (newNodeStakeAfter > maxStake) revert MaxStakeExceeded();\n\n        // Settle score-per-stake indices on BOTH nodes before CSS mutates\n        // effective stake (which shifts the delegator's contribution\n        // between the two nodes at `currentEpoch`).\n        uint256 currentEpoch = chronos.getCurrentEpoch();\n        uint256 oldNodeEpochScore18 = _prepareForStakeChangeV10(currentEpoch, tokenId, oldIdentityId);\n        _prepareForStakeChangeV10(currentEpoch, tokenId, newIdentityId);\n\n        // v10.0.3 \u2014 the score settled on the OLD node for the in-progress\n        // epoch becomes unreachable once `pos.identityId` flips (later\n        // claims read only the current node). Record a carry pointer so\n        // the next claim integrates it against the old node's pool.\n        if (oldNodeEpochScore18 > 0) {\n            convictionStorage.addRewardCarry(\n                tokenId,\n                oldIdentityId,\n                uint32(currentEpoch),\n                bytes32(tokenId)\n            );\n        }\n\n        // D25 \u2014 in-place node swap. tokenId + expiryEpoch + reward cursor\n        // preserved; per-node diffs + per-node raw + pending expiry\n        // subtraction all move from oldIdentityId to newIdentityId.\n        convictionStorage.updateOnRedelegate(tokenId, newIdentityId);\n\n        // Sharding-table maintenance on BOTH nodes gates on V10 canonical stake.\n        ShardingTableStorage sts = shardingTableStorage;\n        uint256 minStake = uint256(parametersStorage.minimumStake());\n\n        uint256 oldNodeStakeAfter = convictionStorage.getNodeStakeV10(oldIdentityId);\n        if (sts.nodeExists(oldIdentityId) && oldNodeStakeAfter < minStake) {\n            shardingTable.removeNode(oldIdentityId);\n        }\n        if (!sts.nodeExists(newIdentityId) && newNodeStakeAfter >= minStake) {\n            _tryAdmitNode(newIdentityId);\n        }\n\n        ask.recalculateActiveSet();\n\n        emit Redelegated(tokenId, oldIdentityId, newIdentityId);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Atomic full withdrawal. Post-expiry (or tier-0 rest state)\n     *         only. Auto-claims any outstanding rewards into `raw`, pays\n     *         out the full `raw` balance from the `StakingStorage` TRAC\n     *         vault to `staker`, and deletes the CSS position. The NFT\n     *         wrapper burns the token on return.\n     *\n     * @dev D14 \u2014 atomic withdraw. No request / cancel / finalize dance,\n     *      no address-timer delay: the lock IS the delay. Partial\n     *      withdrawals are NOT a first-class feature \u2014 a user wanting\n     *      partial liquidity should withdraw the whole position and\n     *      re-stake the remainder, which gives the same economic\n     *      result (tier-0 with 1x multiplier is effectively liquid\n     *      stake). Q3 \u2014 rewards are auto-claimed inside this call so\n     *      the user sees a single button in the UI.\n     */\n    function withdraw(\n        address staker,\n        uint256 tokenId\n    ) external onlyConvictionNFT returns (uint96 amount) {\n        ConvictionStakingStorage.Position memory pos = convictionStorage.getPosition(tokenId);\n        if (pos.identityId == 0) revert PositionNotFound();\n\n        // Lock gate: pre-expiry withdrawals are disallowed. Tier-0\n        // positions (`expiryTimestamp == 0`) always pass \u2014 they are the\n        // rest state with no lock. D26 \u2014 timestamp-accurate.\n        bool unlocked = pos.expiryTimestamp == 0 || block.timestamp >= uint256(pos.expiryTimestamp);\n        if (!unlocked) revert LockStillActive();\n\n        // Auto-claim any outstanding rewards (compounds into `raw`). Must\n        // happen BEFORE reading the final raw, because compounding grows\n        // it. No-op when `currentEpoch <= 1` or nothing is unclaimed.\n        _claim(tokenId);\n\n        // Re-read after auto-claim \u2014 raw may have grown via compounding.\n        pos = convictionStorage.getPosition(tokenId);\n        amount = pos.raw;\n        require(amount > 0, \"No raw\");\n        uint72 identityId = pos.identityId;\n\n        // Delete the position: CSS handles effective-stake diff teardown,\n        // pending-expiry delta cancel, per-node enumeration pop, per-node\n        // raw aggregate decrement, global total decrement, finalization.\n        convictionStorage.deletePosition(tokenId);\n\n        // v4.0.0 \u2014 TRAC flows from the CSS vault to the NFT owner.\n        convictionStorage.transferStake(staker, amount);\n\n        // Sharding-table maintenance: node may have dropped below minStake.\n        uint256 newNodeStake = convictionStorage.getNodeStakeV10(identityId);\n        if (\n            shardingTableStorage.nodeExists(identityId) &&\n            newNodeStake < uint256(parametersStorage.minimumStake())\n        ) {\n            shardingTable.removeNode(identityId);\n        }\n\n        ask.recalculateActiveSet();\n\n        emit Withdrawn(tokenId, staker, amount);\n    }\n\n    // ========================================================================\n    // Operator-fee withdrawal (v4.0.0)\n    //\n    // Operators accrue fees inside `_claim` (the gross-vs-net split). The\n    // accrued balance lives on CSS (`nodeOperatorFeeBalance`); withdrawing\n    // it back to the operator's wallet is a request \u2192 cooldown \u2192 finalize\n    // dance, mirroring V8 `Staking.{request,finalize,cancel}OperatorFeeWithdrawal`\n    // exactly. The cooldown reuses `parametersStorage.stakeWithdrawalDelay`\n    // (no separate operator-fee delay parameter).\n    //\n    // Restake-fee-as-stake is handled by the existing 2-step path\n    // (`finalizeOperatorFeeWithdrawal` \u2192 `DKGStakingConvictionNFT.createConviction`)\n    // \u2014 no dedicated `restakeOperatorFee` primitive exists in V10 because\n    // V10 stake is NFT-keyed and lock-tiered; the operator picks tier on\n    // re-stake.\n    //\n    // \u2500\u2500 Deprecated V8 lifetime statistics \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\n    // V8 `StakingStorage` tracked `operatorFeeCumulative{Earned,PaidOut}Rewards`\n    // (with paired events) so off-chain dashboards could compute lifetime\n    // operator-fee throughput per node. V10 deliberately drops these counters:\n    // the on-chain working set is `nodeOperatorFeeBalance` + queued\n    // `operatorFeeWithdrawals` only. Lifetime analytics for V10 are computed\n    // off-chain by replaying the existing `OperatorFeeBalanceUpdated`,\n    // `OperatorFeeWithdrawalRequestCreated`, and `OperatorFeeWithdrawalRequestDeleted`\n    // events (or via the per-epoch `IsOperatorFeeClaimedForEpoch` flag), and\n    // are not part of the staking-storage surface. Any consumer that needs the\n    // legacy cumulative reads must be ported to event replay; CSS will not be\n    // extended with the V8 fields. Documented here so the omission is\n    // intentional rather than an oversight in the V8\u2192V10 consolidation.\n    // ========================================================================\n\n    /// @notice Initiate an operator-fee withdrawal. Caller must hold ADMIN_KEY\n    ///         on `identityId`. Subsequent calls before finalize/cancel\n    ///         augment the existing request (combined amount = old + new).\n    function requestOperatorFeeWithdrawal(uint72 identityId, uint96 withdrawalAmount) external onlyAdmin(identityId) {\n        if (withdrawalAmount == 0) revert TokenLib.ZeroTokenAmount();\n\n        ConvictionStakingStorage cs = convictionStorage;\n\n        uint96 existingRequestAmount = cs.getOperatorFeeWithdrawalRequestAmount(identityId);\n        uint96 currentOperatorFeeBalance = cs.getOperatorFeeBalance(identityId);\n\n        // If a request already exists, the requested funds were already\n        // moved out of the balance into the queue \u2014 restore them before we\n        // re-check the cap so the totalRequestAmount comparison is honest.\n        if (existingRequestAmount > 0) {\n            currentOperatorFeeBalance += existingRequestAmount;\n        }\n\n        uint96 totalRequestAmount = existingRequestAmount + withdrawalAmount;\n        if (totalRequestAmount > currentOperatorFeeBalance) {\n            revert StakingLib.AmountExceedsOperatorFeeBalance(currentOperatorFeeBalance, totalRequestAmount);\n        }\n\n        uint256 withdrawalReleaseTimestamp = block.timestamp + parametersStorage.stakeWithdrawalDelay();\n        cs.setOperatorFeeBalance(identityId, currentOperatorFeeBalance - totalRequestAmount);\n        cs.createOperatorFeeWithdrawalRequest(identityId, totalRequestAmount, /*indexed*/ 0, withdrawalReleaseTimestamp);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Complete an operator-fee withdrawal after the cooldown has\n    ///         elapsed.
