delete operatorFeeWithdrawals[identityId];\n        emit OperatorFeeWithdrawalRequestDeleted(identityId);\n    }\n\n    function getOperatorFeeWithdrawalRequest(uint72 identityId) external view returns (uint96, uint96, uint256) {\n        StakingLib.StakeWithdrawalRequest memory wr = operatorFeeWithdrawals[identityId];\n        return (wr.amount, wr.indexedOutAmount, wr.timestamp);\n    }\n\n    function getOperatorFeeWithdrawalRequestAmount(uint72 identityId) external view returns (uint96) {\n        return operatorFeeWithdrawals[identityId].amount;\n    }\n\n    function getOperatorFeeWithdrawalRequestIndexedOutAmount(uint72 identityId) external view returns (uint96) {\n        return operatorFeeWithdrawals[identityId].indexedOutAmount;\n    }\n\n    function getOperatorFeeWithdrawalRequestTimestamp(uint72 identityId) external view returns (uint256) {\n        return operatorFeeWithdrawals[identityId].timestamp;\n    }\n\n    function operatorFeeWithdrawalRequestExists(uint72 identityId) external view returns (bool) {\n        return operatorFeeWithdrawals[identityId].amount != 0;\n    }\n\n    // ============================================================\n    //   v4.0.0 \u2014 TRAC vault outflow\n    //\n    // The CSS contract address is the V10 TRAC vault (deposits arrive via\n    // `transferFrom(staker, address(this), amount)` from publish/staking\n    // callers). `transferStake` (stake movement) and `transferRegistrationDepositFee`\n    // (OT-RFC-53 escrow treasury fee) are the outflow paths; both gated to Hub-\n    // registered contracts, mirroring V8 `StakingStorage.transferStake`.\n    // ============================================================\n\n    function transferStake(address receiver, uint96 stakeAmount) external onlyContracts {\n        // Slither: `safeTransfer` (SafeERC20) reverts on failure rather than\n        // returning false \u2014 the \"unchecked-transfer\" pattern Slither flags\n        // applies to the bare ERC20 `.transfer()` return-value path. This\n        // call site is the SAFE wrapper precisely BECAUSE the V10 design\n        // upgraded V8's bare `.transfer()` (see StakingStorage.transferStake)\n        // to SafeERC20. False positive \u2014 kept here as a directive for\n        // future maintainers debugging the report.\n        // slither-disable-next-line unchecked-transfer\n        tokenContract.safeTransfer(receiver, stakeAmount);\n        emit StakedTokensTransferred(receiver, stakeAmount);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice OT-RFC-53: routes the protocol treasury fee owed on an escrow-funded\n    ///         publish/update/extend out of the vault to `treasury`. The SECOND\n    ///         vault-outflow path; mirrors {transferStake} (gated to Hub contracts,\n    ///         SafeERC20). The caller (KnowledgeAssetsLifecycle) computes `amount`\n    ///         (bounded by the consumed escrow) and passes the configured\n    ///         `protocolTreasury`; CSS performs only the gated transfer.\n    function transferRegistrationDepositFee(address treasury, uint96 amount) external onlyContracts {\n        // slither-disable-next-line unchecked-transfer\n        tokenContract.safeTransfer(treasury, amount);\n        emit RegistrationDepositFeeTransferred(treasury, amount);\n    }\n\n    // ============================================================\n    //                       Internal helpers\n    // ============================================================\n\n    /**\n     * @dev Wall-clock expiry computation (D26). Boosts last at least the tier\n     *      duration and expire on the next 12-hour bucket. Returns 0 for tier-0\n     *      (permanent rest state).\n     */\n    function _computeExpiryTimestamp(uint40 lockTier) internal view returns (uint40) {\n        if (lockTier == 0) return 0;\n        uint256 duration = _tierDuration(lockTier);\n        uint256 exp = block.timestamp + duration;\n        return _bucketExpiryTimestamp(exp);\n    }\n\n    function _bucketExpiryTimestamp(uint256 rawExpiry) internal pure returns (uint40) {\n        uint256 bucket = uint256(EXPIRY_BUCKET_SECONDS);\n        uint256 bucketed = ((rawExpiry + bucket - 1) / bucket) * bucket;\n        require(bucketed <= type(uint40).max, \"Expiry overflow\");\n        return uint40(bucketed);\n    }\n\n    function _pushNodeToken(uint72 identityId, uint256 tokenId) internal {\n        nodeTokenIndex[identityId][tokenId] = nodeTokens[identityId].length;\n        nodeTokens[identityId].push(tokenId);\n    }\n\n    function _popNodeToken(uint72 identityId, uint256 tokenId) internal {\n        uint256[] storage arr = nodeTokens[identityId];\n        uint256 idx = nodeTokenIndex[identityId][tokenId];\n        uint256 last = arr.length - 1;\n        if (idx != last) {\n            uint256 movedToken = arr[last];\n            arr[idx] = movedToken;\n            nodeTokenIndex[identityId][movedToken] = idx;\n        }\n        arr.pop();\n        delete nodeTokenIndex[identityId][tokenId];\n    }\n\n    function _increaseNodeStakeV10(uint72 identityId, uint256 amount) internal {\n        nodeStakeV10[identityId] += amount;\n        totalStakeV10 += amount;\n        emit NodeStakeV10Increased(identityId, amount, nodeStakeV10[identityId], totalStakeV10);\n    }\n\n    function _decreaseNodeStakeV10(uint72 identityId, uint256 amount) internal {\n        nodeStakeV10[identityId] -= amount;\n        totalStakeV10 -= amount;\n        emit NodeStakeV10Decreased(identityId, amount, nodeStakeV10[identityId], totalStakeV10);\n    }\n}\n","keccak256":"0x52c35cbd4d06b4765f837089b13202cd1cca5023be8df9e481cdc00892acaa62","license":"Apache-2.0"},"contracts/storage/EpochStorage.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\n\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\n\nimport {Chronos} from \"./Chronos.sol\";\nimport {HubDependent} from \"../abstract/HubDependent.sol\";\nimport {INamed} from \"../interfaces/INamed.sol\";\nimport {IVersioned} from \"../interfaces/IVersioned.sol\";\n\ncontract EpochStorage is INamed, IVersioned, HubDependent {\n    string private constant _NAME = \"EpochStorage\";\n    // 10.0.4 \u2014 OT-RFC-51 \"Publishing Allocation\": the per-node\n    //          produced-knowledge-value accounting is repurposed as\n    //          committed PCA \"publishing allocation\". The mappings,\n    //          mutator, event, and getters are renamed\n    //          (`*ProducedKnowledgeValue*` -> `*PublishingAllocation*`)\n    //          and a net-zero `moveEpochPublishingAllocation` mutator is\n    //          added so a PCA can re-designate its primary node without\n    //          changing the epoch total (K_total).\n    string private constant _VERSION = \"10.0.4\";\n\n    event EpochPublishingAllocationAdded(uint72 indexed identityId, uint256 indexed epoch, uint96 amount);\n    event TokensAddedToEpochRange(\n        uint256 indexed shardId,\n        uint256 startEpoch,\n        uint256 endEpoch,\n        uint96 tokenAmount,\n        uint96 remainder\n    );\n    event EpochTokensPaidOut(uint256 indexed shardId, uint256 indexed epoch, uint72 indexed identityId, uint96 amount);\n    event EpochsFinalized(uint256 indexed shardId, uint256 startEpoch, uint256 endEpoch);\n\n    Chronos public chronos;\n\n    mapping(uint256 => uint256) public lastFinalizedEpoch;\n    mapping(uint256 => uint96) public accumulatedRemainder;\n\n    mapping(uint256 => mapping(uint256 => int96)) public diff;\n    mapping(uint256 => mapping(uint256 => uint96)) public cumulative;\n    mapping(uint256 => mapping(uint256 => uint96)) public distributed;\n\n    mapping(uint72 => mapping(uint256 => uint96)) public nodesEpochPublishingAllocation;\n    mapping(uint256 => uint96) public epochPublishingAllocation;\n    mapping(uint256 => uint96) public epochNodeMaxPublishingAllocation;\n\n    mapping(uint72 => mapping(uint256 => mapping(uint256 => uint96))) public nodesPaidOut;\n\n    constructor(address hubAddress) HubDependent(hubAddress) {}\n\n    function initialize() public onlyHub {\n        chronos = Chronos(hub.getContractAddress(\"Chronos\"));\n    }\n\n    function name() external pure virtual override returns (string memory) {\n        return _NAME;\n    }\n\n    function version() external pure virtual override returns (string memory) {\n        return _VERSION;\n    }\n\n    function addEpochPublishingAllocation(\n        uint72 identityId,\n        uint256 epoch,\n        uint96 amount\n    ) external onlyContracts {\n        nodesEpochPublishingAllocation[identityId][epoch] += amount;\n        epochPublishingAllocation[epoch] += amount;\n\n        // Maintain the per-epoch node max so its (public) getters stay\n        // consistent. The OT-RFC-51 scoring path does NOT read it\n        // (RandomSampling reads only getNodeEpochPublishingAllocation /\n        // getEpochPublishingAllocation), but the mapping cannot be removed \u2014\n        // it precedes `nodesPaidOut` in this persistent (non-fresh-state)\n        // storage layout \u2014 and leaving it written-nowhere/read-in-getters\n        // trips Slither's uninitialized-state finding. The compare/SSTORE is\n        // negligible against the surrounding accounting.\n        if (nodesEpochPublishingAllocation[identityId][epoch] > epochNodeMaxPublishingAllocation[epoch]) {\n            epochNodeMaxPublishingAllocation[epoch] = nodesEpochPublishingAllocation[identityId][epoch];\n        }\n\n        emit EpochPublishingAllocationAdded(identityId, epoch, amount);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice OT-RFC-51: move `amount` of publishing allocation from one\n    ///         node to another within a single `epoch`. Used when a PCA\n    ///         re-designates its primary node \u2014 the epoch total\n    ///         (`epochPublishingAllocation`, i.e. K_total) is intentionally\n    ///         NOT touched, so the move is net-zero on the denominator of\n    ///         every node's publishing factor.\n    /// @dev    `epochNodeMaxPublishingAllocation` is a per-epoch HIGH-WATER\n    ///         MARK, maintained identically on the add and move paths: it is\n    ///         only ever RAISED (when the destination's new value exceeds it),\n    ///         never lowered by the `fromId` decrement \u2014 computing the true\n    ///         current max after a decrement would need an O(nodes) scan.\n    ///         Nothing on-chain reads it (scoring reads only\n    ///         get(Node)EpochPublishingAllocation); it exists for off-chain\n    ///         observability, for which the high-water-mark semantic is correct.\n    function moveEpochPublishingAllocation(\n        uint72 fromId,\n        uint72 toId,\n        uint256 epoch,\n        uint96 amount\n    ) external onlyContracts {\n        nodesEpochPublishingAllocation[fromId][epoch] -= amount;\n        nodesEpochPublishingAllocation[toId][epoch] += amount; // epoch total unchanged -> K_total net-zero\n\n        if (nodesEpochPublishingAllocation[toId][epoch] > epochNodeMaxPublishingAllocation[epoch]) {\n            epochNodeMaxPublishingAllocation[epoch] = nodesEpochPublishingAllocation[toId][epoch];\n        }\n    }\n\n    function getEpochPublishingAllocation(uint256 epoch) external view returns (uint96) {\n        return epochPublishingAllocation[epoch];\n    }\n\n    function getCurrentEpochPublishingAllocation() external view returns (uint96) {\n        return epochPublishingAllocation[chronos.getCurrentEpoch()];\n    }\n\n    function getPreviousEpochPublishingAllocation() external view returns (uint96) {\n        uint256 currentEpoch = chronos.getCurrentEpoch();\n        if (currentEpoch <= 1) {\n            return 0;\n        }\n        return epochPublishingAllocation[currentEpoch - 1];\n    }\n\n    function getNodeEpochPublishingAllocation(uint72 identityId, uint256 epoch) external view returns (uint96) {\n        return nodesEpochPublishingAllocation[identityId][epoch];\n    }\n\n    function getNodeCurrentEpochPublishingAllocation(uint72 identityId) external view returns (uint96) {\n        return nodesEpochPublishingAllocation[identityId][chronos.getCurrentEpoch()];\n    }\n\n    function getNodePreviousEpochPublishingAllocation(uint72 identityId) external view returns (uint96) {\n        uint256 currentEpoch = chronos.getCurrentEpoch();\n        if (currentEpoch <= 1) {\n            return 0;\n        }\n        return nodesEpochPublishingAllocation[identityId][currentEpoch - 1];\n    }\n\n    function getEpochNodeMaxPublishingAllocation(uint256 epoch) external view returns (uint96) {\n        return epochNodeMaxPublishingAllocation[epoch];\n    }\n\n    function getCurrentEpochNodeMaxPublishingAllocation() external view returns (uint96) {\n        return epochNodeMaxPublishingAllocation[chronos.getCurrentEpoch()];\n    }\n\n    function getPreviousEpochNodeMaxPublishingAllocation() external view returns (uint96) {\n        uint256 currentEpoch = chronos.getCurrentEpoch();\n        if (currentEpoch <= 1) {\n            return 0;\n        }\n        return epochNodeMaxPublishingAllocation[currentEpoch - 1];\n    }\n\n    function getNodeEpochPublishingAllocationPercentage(\n        uint72 identityId,\n        uint256 epoch\n    ) external view returns (uint256) {\n        if (epochPublishingAllocation[epoch] == 0) {\n            return 0;\n        }\n\n        return\n            (uint256(nodesEpochPublishingAllocation[identityId][epoch]) * 1e18) / epochPublishingAllocation[epoch];\n    }\n\n    function getNodeCurrentEpochPublishingAllocationPercentage(uint72 identityId) external view returns (uint256) {\n        uint256 currentEpoch = chronos.getCurrentEpoch();\n\n        if (epochPublishingAllocation[currentEpoch] == 0) {\n            return 0;\n        }\n\n        return ((uint256(nodesEpochPublishingAllocation[identityId][currentEpoch]) * 1e18) /\n            epochPublishingAllocation[currentEpoch]);\n    }\n\n    function getNodePreviousEpochPublishingAllocationPercentage(uint72 identityId) external view returns (uint256) {\n        uint256 currentEpoch = chronos.getCurrentEpoch();\n        if (currentEpoch <= 1 || epochPublishingAllocation[currentEpoch - 1] == 0) {\n            return 0;\n        }\n        return ((uint256(nodesEpochPublishingAllocation[identityId][currentEpoch - 1]) * 1e18) /\n            epochPublishingAllocation[currentEpoch - 1]);\n    }\n\n    function addTokensToEpochRange(\n        uint256 shardId,\n        uint256 startEpoch,\n        uint256 endEpoch,\n        uint96 tokenAmount\n    ) external onlyContracts {\n        // SECURITY FIX: a credit whose startEpoch is already FINALIZED is\n        // otherwise lost forever. `_finalizeEpochsUpTo` only folds `diff` for\n        // `(lastFinalizedEpoch, currentEpoch-1]` and never revisits a finalized\n        // epoch, so `diff[startEpoch] += p` at `startEpoch <= lastFinalizedEpoch`\n        // is never folded into `cumulative` (the tokens vanish \u2014 stranded in the\n        // contract with no payable pool entry) and the paired\n        // `diff[endEpoch+1] -= p` later under-credits an unrelated future epoch.\n        //\n        // Clamp the range up to `lastFinalizedEpoch + 1` \u2014 the first epoch NOT\n        // yet folded into `cumulative`, and therefore still payable (epochs above\n        // `lastFinalizedEpoch` are read via on-the-fly simulation in\n        // `getEpochPool`). This is the minimal correction: it rescues only the\n        // credits that were genuinely lost (finalized epochs) and lands them in\n        // the CLOSEST still-creditable epoch, preserving the caller's intended\n        // attribution as much as possible \u2014 PublishingConviction deliberately\n        // attributes a closed billing window to the chain epochs it overlapped,\n        // so forcing `currentEpoch` here would misattribute/delay those rewards\n        // on an idle shard. Any stricter \"settle into the current epoch\" policy\n        // belongs at the specific caller, not in this shared primitive. Clamp,\n        // don't revert: lazy past-window settlement is an intended pattern.\n        uint256 firstOpenEpoch = lastFinalizedEpoch[shardId] + 1;\n        if (startEpoch < firstOpenEpoch) {\n            startEpoch = firstOpenEpoch;\n            if (endEpoch < startEpoch) {\n                endEpoch = startEpoch;\n            }\n        }\n\n        uint256 numEpochs = endEpoch - startEpoch + 1;\n\n        uint96 totalTokens = tokenAmount + accumulatedRemainder[shardId];\n        uint96 tokensPerEpochU = uint96(totalTokens / numEpochs);\n        uint96 remainder = uint96(totalTokens % numEpochs);\n\n        accumulatedRemainder[shardId] = remainder;\n\n        int96 tokensPerEpoch = int96(tokensPerEpochU);\n\n        diff[shardId][startEpoch] += tokensPerEpoch;\n        diff[shardId][endEpoch + 1] -= tokensPerEpoch;\n\n        uint256 currentEpoch = chronos.getCurrentEpoch();\n        if (currentEpoch > 1) {\n            _finalizeEpochsUpTo(shardId, currentEpoch - 1);\n        }\n\n        emit TokensAddedToEpochRange(shardId, startEpoch, endEpoch, tokenAmount, remainder);\n    }\n\n    function payOutEpochTokens(\n        uint256 shardId,\n        uint256 epoch,\n        uint72 identityId,\n        uint96 amount\n    ) external onlyContracts {\n        uint256 currentEpoch = chronos.getCurrentEpoch();\n        if (currentEpoch > 1) {\n            _finalizeEpochsUpTo(shardId, currentEpoch - 1);\n        }\n\n        distributed[shardId][epoch] += amount;\n        nodesPaidOut[identityId][shardId][epoch] += amount;\n\n        emit EpochTokensPaidOut(shardId, epoch, identityId, amount);\n    }\n\n    function getEpochPool(uint256 shardId, uint256 epoch) public view returns (uint96) {\n        if (epoch <= lastFinalizedEpoch[shardId]) {\n            return cumulative[shardId][epoch];\n        } else {\n            return _simulateEpochFinalization(shardId, epoch);\n        }\n    }\n\n    function getEpochRemainingPool(uint256 shardId, uint256 epoch) public view returns (uint96) {\n        if (epoch <= lastFinalizedEpoch[shardId]) {\n            return cumulative[shardId][epoch] - distributed[shardId][epoch];\n        } else {\n            return _simulateEpochFinalization(shardId, epoch) - distributed[shardId][epoch];\n        }\n    }\n\n    function getCurrentEpochPool(uint256 shardId) external view returns (uint96) {\n        return getEpochPool(shardId, chronos.getCurrentEpoch());\n    }\n\n    function getCurrentEpochRemainingPool(uint256 shardId) external view returns (uint96) {\n        return getEpochRemainingPool(shardId, chronos.getCurrentEpoch());\n    }\n\n    function getPreviousEpochPool(uint256 shardId) external view returns (uint96) {\n        uint256 currentEpoch = chronos.getCurrentEpoch();\n        if (currentEpoch <= 1) {\n            return 0;\n        }\n        return getEpochPool(shardId, currentEpoch - 1);\n    }\n\n    function getPreviousEpochRemainingPool(uint256 shardId) external view returns (uint96) {\n        uint256 currentEpoch = chronos.getCurrentEpoch();\n        if (currentEpoch <= 1) {\n            return 0;\n        }\n        return getEpochRemainingPool(shardId, currentEpoch - 1);\n    }\n\n    function getEpochRangePool(uint256 shardId, uint256 startEpoch, uint256 endEpoch) external view returns (uint96) {\n        uint256 lastFinalized = lastFinalizedEpoch[shardId];\n        uint96 totalPool = 0;\n\n        if (startEpoch <= lastFinalized) {\n            for (uint256 epoch = startEpoch; epoch <= lastFinalized && epoch <= endEpoch; epoch++) {\n                totalPool += cumulative[shardId][epoch];\n            }\n        }\n\n        uint96 simulatedCumulative = lastFinalized > 0 ? cumulative[shardId][lastFinalized] : cumulative[shardId][1];\n        for (uint256 epoch = lastFinalized + 1; epoch <= endEpoch; epoch++) {\n            int96 tmp = int96(simulatedCumulative) + diff[shardId][epoch];\n            simulatedCumulative = uint96(tmp);\n            if (epoch >= startEpoch) {\n                totalPool += simulatedCumulative;\n            }\n        }\n\n        return totalPool;\n    }\n\n    function getEpochDistributedPool(uint256 shardId, uint256 epoch) external view returns (uint96) {\n        return distributed[shardId][epoch];\n    }\n\n    function getPreviousEpochDistributedPool(uint256 shardId) external view returns (uint96) {\n        uint256 currentEpoch = chronos.getCurrentEpoch();\n        if (currentEpoch <= 1) {\n            return 0;\n        }\n        return distributed[shardId][currentEpoch - 1];\n    }\n\n    function getNodeEpochPaidOut(uint256 shardId, uint72 identityId, uint256 epoch) external view returns (uint96) {\n        return nodesPaidOut[identityId][shardId][epoch];\n    }\n\n    function getNodePreviousEpochPaidOut(uint256 shardId, uint72 identityId) external view returns (uint96) {\n        uint256 currentEpoch = chronos.getCurrentEpoch();\n        if (currentEpoch <= 1) {\n            return 0;\n        }\n        return nodesPaidOut[identityId][shardId][currentEpoch - 1];\n    }\n\n    function _finalizeEpochsUpTo(uint256 shardId, uint256 epoch) internal {\n        uint256 startEpoch = lastFinalizedEpoch[shardId] + 1;\n        for (uint256 e = startEpoch; e <= epoch; e++) {\n            int96 prev = 0;\n            if (e > 1) {\n                prev = int96(cumulative[shardId][e - 1]);\n            }\n            cumulative[shardId][e] = uint96(prev + diff[shardId][e]);\n        }\n        lastFinalizedEpoch[shardId] = epoch;\n\n        emit EpochsFinalized(shardId, startEpoch, epoch);\n    }\n\n    function _simulateEpochFinalization(uint256 shardId, uint256 epoch) internal view returns (uint96) {\n        if (epoch <= lastFinalizedEpoch[shardId]) {\n            return cumulative[shardId][epoch];\n        }\n\n        uint96 simulatedCumulative = 0;\n        if (lastFinalizedEpoch[shardId] > 0) {\n            simulatedCumulative = cumulative[shardId][lastFinalizedEpoch[shardId]];\n        }\n\n        for (uint256 e = lastFinalizedEpoch[shardId] + 1; e <= epoch; e++) {\n            int96 prev = int96(simulatedCumulative);\n            int96 result = prev + diff[shardId][e];\n            simulatedCumulative = uint96(result);\n        }\n\n        return simulatedCumulative;\n    }\n}\n","keccak256":"0x74fd4c074d1dbe46453f8ffb5ed1cf3db3ca100604d631b46f5be40860bd0835","license":"Apache-2.0"},"contracts/storage/Hub.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\n\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\n\nimport {IContractStatus} from \"../interfaces/IContractStatus.sol\";\nimport {ICustodian} from \"../interfaces/ICustodian.sol\";\nimport {IInitializable} from \"../interfaces/IInitializable.sol\";\nimport {INamed} from \"../interfaces/INamed.sol\";\nimport {IVersioned} from \"../interfaces/IVersioned.sol\";\nimport {HubLib} from \"../libraries/HubLib.sol\";\nimport {UnorderedNamedContractDynamicSet} from \"../libraries/UnorderedNamedContractDynamicSet.sol\";\nimport {Ownable} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol\";\n\ncontract Hub is INamed, IVersioned, Ownable {\n    using UnorderedNamedContractDynamicSet for UnorderedNamedContractDynamicSet.Set;\n\n    event NewContract(string contractName, address newContractAddress);\n    event ContractChanged(string contractName, address newContractAddress);\n    event NewAssetStorage(string contractName, address newContractAddress);\n    event AssetStorageChanged(string contractName, address newContractAddress);\n    event ContractRemoved(string contractName, address contractAddress);\n    event AssetStorageRemoved(string contractName, address contractAddress);\n\n    string private constant _NAME = \"Hub\";\n    string private constant _VERSION = \"1.0.0\";\n\n    UnorderedNamedContractDynamicSet.Set internal contractSet;\n    UnorderedNamedContractDynamicSet.Set internal assetStorageSet;\n\n    constructor() Ownable(msg.sender) {}\n\n    // @dev Only transactions by HubController owner or one of the owners of the MultiSig Wallet\n    modifier onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner() {\n        _checkOwnerOrMultiSigOwner();\n        _;\n    }\n\n    function name() external pure virtual override returns (string memory) {\n        return _NAME;\n    }\n\n    function version() external pure virtual override returns (string memory) {\n        return _VERSION;\n    }\n\n    function setContractAddress(\n        string calldata contractName,\n        address newContractAddress\n    ) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        _setContractAddress(contractName, newContractAddress);\n    }\n\n    function setAssetStorageAddress(string calldata assetStorageName, address assetStorageAddress) external onlyOwner {\n        _setAssetStorageAddress(assetStorageName, assetStorageAddress);\n    }\n\n    function removeContractByName(string calldata contractName) external onlyOwner {\n        if (contractSet.exists(contractName)) {\n            address contractAddress = contractSet.get(contractName).addr;\n\n            contractSet.remove(contractName);\n\n            emit ContractRemoved(contractName, contractAddress);\n        }\n    }\n\n    function removeContractByAddress(address contractAddress) external onlyOwner {\n        if (contractSet.exists(contractAddress)) {\n            string memory contractName = contractSet.get(contractAddress).name;\n\n            contractSet.remove(contractAddress);\n\n            emit ContractRemoved(contractName, contractAddress);\n        }\n    }\n\n    function removeAssetStorageByName(string calldata assetStorageName) external onlyOwner {\n        if (assetStorageSet.exists(assetStorageName)) {\n            address assetStorageAddress = assetStorageSet.get(assetStorageName).addr;\n\n            assetStorageSet.remove(assetStorageName);\n\n            emit AssetStorageRemoved(assetStorageName, assetStorageAddress);\n        }\n    }\n\n    function removeAssetStorageByAddress(address assetStorageAddress) external onlyOwner {\n        if (assetStorageSet.exists(assetStorageAddress)) {\n            string memory assetStorageName = assetStorageSet.get(assetStorageAddress).name;\n\n            assetStorageSet.remove(assetStorageAddress);\n\n            emit AssetStorageRemoved(assetStorageName, assetStorageAddress);\n        }\n    }\n\n    function getContractAddress(string calldata contractName) external view returns (address) {\n        return contractSet.get(contractName).addr;\n    }\n\n    function getAssetStorageAddress(string calldata assetStorageName) external view returns (address) {\n        return assetStorageSet.get(assetStorageName).addr;\n    }\n\n    function getAllContracts() external view returns (UnorderedNamedContractDynamicSet.Contract[] memory) {\n        return contractSet.getAll();\n    }\n\n    function getAllAssetStorages() external view returns (UnorderedNamedContractDynamicSet.Contract[] memory) {\n        return assetStorageSet.getAll();\n    }\n\n    function isContract(string calldata contractName) external view returns (bool) {\n        return contractSet.exists(contractName);\n    }\n\n    function isContract(address selectedContractAddress) external view returns (bool) {\n        return contractSet.exists(selectedContractAddress);\n    }\n\n    function isAssetStorage(string calldata assetStorageName) external view returns (bool) {\n        return assetStorageSet.exists(assetStorageName);\n    }\n\n    function isAssetStorage(address assetStorageAddress) external view returns (bool) {\n        return assetStorageSet.exists(assetStorageAddress);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @dev Forwards a function call to a specified target contract.\n     * @notice This function can only be called by the contract owner or a multisig owner.\n     * @param target The address of the target contract.\n     * @param data The calldata containing the function signature and arguments for the target contract's function.\n     * @return result The return data of the target contract's function call.\n     */\n    function forwardCall(address target, bytes calldata data) public onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner returns (bytes memory) {\n        // Check if the target contract is registered in the Hub\n        if (!contractSet.exists(target) && !assetStorageSet.exists(target)) {\n            revert HubLib.InvalidTargetContract(target);\n        }\n\n        // Perform the function call to the target contract with the specified calldata\n        (bool success, bytes memory result) = Revert the transaction with the return data as the revert reason\n                revert(ptr, size)\n            }\n        }\n\n        return result;\n    }\n\n    function   HubLib.ForwardCallInputArgs[] calldata forwardCallsData\n    ) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        _setContracts(newContracts);\n        _setAssetStorageContracts(newAssetStorageContracts);\n        _reinitializeContracts(contractsToReinitialize);\n        _forwardCalls(forwardCallsData);\n    }\n\n    function ignore.\n                }\n            }\n\n            emit ContractChanged(contractName, newContractAddress);\n        } else {\n            contractSet.append(contractName,   }\n        }\n\n        emit NewContract(contractName, newContractAddress);\n    }\n\n    function _setContracts(HubLib.Contract[] calldata newContracts) internal {\n        for (uint256 i; i < newContracts.length; ) {\n            _setContractAddress(newContracts[i].name, newContracts[i].addr);\n\n            unchecked {\n                i++;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    function _setAssetStorageAddress(string calldata assetStorageName, address assetStorageAddress) internal {\n        if (assetStorageSet.exists(assetStorageName)) {\n            emit NewAssetStorage(assetStorageName, assetStorageAddress);\n            assetStorageSet.append(assetStorageName, assetStorageAddress);\n        }\n    }\n\n    function _setAssetStorageContracts(HubLib.Contract[] calldata newAssetStorageContracts) internal {\n        for (uint256 i; i < newAssetStorageContracts.length; ) {\n            _setAssetStorageAddress(newAssetStorageContracts[i].name, newAssetStorageContracts[i].addr);\n\n            unchecked {\n                i++;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    function _reinitializeContracts(address[] calldata contractsToReinitialize) internal {\n        for (uint256 i; i < contractsToReinitialize.length; ) {\n            IInitializable(contractsToReinitialize[i]).initialize();\n            unchecked {\n                i++;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    function _forwardCalls(HubLib.ForwardCallInputArgs[] calldata forwardCallsData) internal {\n        for (uint256 i; i < forwardCallsData.length; ) {\n            address contractAddress;\n\n            // Try to get the contract address using getContractAddress\n            try this.getContractAddress(forwardCallsData[i].contractName) returns (address addr) {\n                contractAddress = addr;\n            } catch {\n                // If getContractAddress fails, try getAssetStorageAddress\n                try this.getAssetStorageAddress(forwardCallsData[i].contractName) returns (address addr) {\n                    contractAddress = addr;\n                } catch {\n                    revert HubLib.ContractNotRegistered(forwardCallsData[i].contractName);\n                }\n            }\n            for (uint256 j; j < forwardCallsData[i].encodedData.length; ) {\n                forwardCall(contractAddress, forwardCallsData[i].encodedData[j]);\n                unchecked {\n                    j++;\n                }\n            }\n            unchecked {\n                i++;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    function _isContract(address addr) internal view returns (bool) {\n        uint256 size;\n        assembly {\n            size := extcodesize(addr)\n        }\n        return size > 0;\n    }\n\n    function _isMultiSigOwner(address multiSigAddress) internal view returns (bool) {\n        try ICustodian(multiSigAddress).getOwners() returns (address[] memory multiSigOwners) {\n            for (uint256 i = 0; i < multiSigOwners.length; i++) {\n                if (msg.sender == multiSigOwners[i]) {\n                    return true;\n                }\n            }\n        } catch {\n            // Not a multisig or call reverted; treat as not owner.\n        }\n\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    function _checkOwnerOrMultiSigOwner() internal view virtual {\n        address hubOwner = owner();\n        if (msg.sender != hubOwner && !_isMultiSigOwner(hubOwner)) {\n            revert HubLib.UnauthorizedAccess(\"Only Hub Owner or Multisig Owner\");\n        }\n    }\n}\n","keccak256":"0x732252bb857277a35ab314beef2dbaceb5f96ce2f6d3b83a224927e503609def","license":"Apache-2.0"},"contracts/storage/IdentityStorage.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\n\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\n\nimport {HubDependent} from \"../abstract/HubDependent.sol\";\nimport {IERC734Extended} from \"../interfaces/IERC734Extended.sol\";\nimport {INamed} from \"../libraries/IdentityLib.sol\";\nimport {IdentityStorage} from \"../storage/IdentityStorage.sol\";\n\ncontract IdentityStorage is IERC734Extended, INamed, IVersioned, HubDependent {\n    using ByteArr for bytes32[];\n\n    string private constant _NAME = \"IdentityStorage\";\n    string private constant _VERSION = \"10.0.2\";\n\n    uint72 public lastIdentityId;\n\n    struct Identity {\n        mapping(bytes32 => Key) keys;\n        mapping(uint256 => bytes32[]) keysByPurpose;\n    }\n\n    // operationalKey => identityId\n    mapping(bytes32 => uint72) public identityIds;\n    // identityId => Identity\n    mapping(uint72 => Identity) internal identities;\n\n    constructor(address hubAddress) HubDependent(hubAddress) {}\n\n    function name() external pure virtual override returns (string memory) {\n        return _NAME;\n    }\n\n    function version() external pure virtual override returns (string memory) {\n        return _VERSION;\n    }\n\n    function operationalKeysNumber = operationalKeys.length;\n\n        for (uint256 i; i < operationalKeysNumber; ) {\n            delete identityIds[operationalKeys[i]];\n            unchecked {\n                i++;\n            }\n        }\n\n        delete identities[identityId];\n    }\n\n    function addKey(\n        uint72 identityId,\n        bytes32 _key,\n        uint256 _purpose,\n        uint256 _type\n    ) external virtual override onlyContracts {\n        Identity storage identity = identities[identityId];\n        identity.keys[_key].purpose = _purpose;\n        identity.keys[_key].keyType = _type;\n        identity.keys[_key].key = _key;\n        identity.keysByPurpose[_purpose].push(_key);\n\n        emit KeyAdded(identityId, _key, _purpose, _type);\n    }\n\n    function removeKey(uint72 identityId, bytes32 _key) external virtual override onlyContracts {\n        IdentityStorage.Identity storage identity = identities[identityId];\n\n        uint256 index;\n        (index, ) = identity.keysByPurpose[identity.keys[_key].purpose].indexOf(_key);\n        identity.keysByPurpose[identity.keys[_key].purpose].removeByIndex(index);\n\n        emit KeyRemoved(identityId, identity.keys[_key].key, identity.keys[_key].purpose, identity.keys[_key].keyType);\n\n        delete identity.keys[_key];\n    }\n\n    function keyHasPurpose(\n        uint72 identityId,\n        bytes32 _key,\n        uint256 _purpose\n    ) external view virtual override returns (bool) {\n        return identities[identityId].keys[_key].purpose == _purpose;\n    }\n\n    function getKey(\n        uint72 identityId,\n        bytes32 _key\n    ) external view virtual override returns (uint256, uint256, bytes32) {\n        return (\n            identities[identityId].keys[_key].purpose,\n            identities[identityId].keys[_key].keyType,\n            identities[identityId].keys[_key].key\n        );\n    }\n\n    function getKeysByPurpose(\n        uint72 identityId,\n        uint256 _purpose\n    ) external view virtual override returns (bytes32[] memory) {\n        return identities[identityId].keysByPurpose[_purpose];\n    }\n\n    function getIdentityId(address operational) external view returns (uint72) {\n        return identityIds[keccak256(abi.encodePacked(operational))];\n    }\n\n    function setOperationalKeyIdentityId(bytes32 operationalKey, uint72 identityId) external virtual onlyContracts {\n        identityIds[operationalKey] = identityId;\n    }\n\n    function removeOperationalKeyIdentityId(bytes32 operationalKey) external virtual onlyContracts {\n        delete identityIds[operationalKey];\n    }\n\n    function setLastIdentityId(uint72 identityId) external virtual onlyContracts {\n        lastIdentityId = identityId;\n    }\n\n    function generateIdentityId() external virtual onlyContracts returns (uint72) {\n        unchecked {\n            return ++lastIdentityId;\n        }\n    }\n}\n","keccak256":"0xef5c32eff475aef41483352683fad4e27f33e2bb9d4a0b891cf02e1987acce91","license":"Apache-2.0"},"contracts/storage/ParametersStorage.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\n\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\n\nimport {HubDependent} from \"../abstract/HubDependent.sol\";\nimport {INamed} from \"../interfaces/INamed.sol\";\nimport {IVersioned} from \"../interfaces/IVersioned.sol\";\nimport {ICustodian} from \"../interfaces/ICustodian.sol\";\n\ncontract ParametersStorage is INamed, IVersioned, HubDependent {\n    event ParameterChanged(string parameterName, uint256 parameterValue);\n    /// @notice Emitted when the protocol treasury recipient changes. The\n    ///         address is carried in its own event (rather than the\n    ///         `uint256`-valued `ParameterChanged`) so off-chain indexers get a\n    ///         typed `address` field.\n    event ProtocolTreasurySet(address indexed treasury);\n\n    error ZeroShardingTableSizeLimit();\n\n    string private constant _NAME = \"ParametersStorage\";\n    // protocol treasury fee (`protocolTreasuryFee`, `protocolTreasury`,\n    // `MAX_PROTOCOL_TREASURY_FEE`) skimmed from the staker-bound TRAC on\n    // every paid publish / update / lifetime-extension.\n    string private constant _VERSION = \"10.0.4\";\n\n    uint96 public minimumStake;\n    uint96 public maximumStake;\n\n    uint256 public stakeWithdrawalDelay;\n    uint256 public nodeAskUpdateDelay;\n    uint256 public operatorFeeUpdateDelay;\n\n    uint16 public opWalletsLimitOnProfileCreation;\n    uint16 public shardingTableSizeLimit;\n\n    uint256 public minimumRequiredSignatures;\n\n    uint256 public askUpperBoundFactor;\n    uint256 public askLowerBoundFactor;\n\n    uint16 public maxOperatorFee;\n\n    uint256 public v81ReleaseEpoch;\n    uint256 public publishingConvictionEpochs;\n\n    /// @notice Protocol treasury fee in basis points (out of 10_000) skimmed\n    ///         from the staker-bound TRAC on every paid publish / update /\n    ///         lifetime-extension. The fee is taken out of the amount that\n    ///         would otherwise flow to the staker reward pool \u2014 it does NOT\n    ///         change the price a publisher pays. Default 300 (3%).\n    ///\n    ///         The fee is a no-op while `protocolTreasury == address(0)`\n    ///         (the full amount flows to stakers), so it stays dormant until\n    ///         governance wires a treasury recipient via `setProtocolTreasury`.\n    uint16 public protocolTreasuryFee;\n\n    /// @notice Recipient of the protocol treasury fee. The zero address\n    ///         disables the fee entirely regardless of `protocolTreasuryFee`.\n    address public protocolTreasury;\n\n    /// @notice Minimum TRAC deposit required to register a Context Graph\n    ///         on-chain (`ContextGraphs.createContextGraph`). The deposit is\n    ///         held as the CG's prepaid publishing escrow \u2014 spendable by the\n    ///         CG owner on publish/update/extend into that CG \u2014 and is never\n    ///         cash-refundable (residue sweeps to the staker reward pool on\n    ///         deactivation). Anti-spam for the unbounded-CG-creation DoS\n    ///         (OT-RFC-53). Setting it to 0 disables the deposit (dormant).\n    uint96 public contextGraphRegistrationDeposit;\n\n    /// @notice Hard upper bound on `protocolTreasuryFee` (10%). Bounds\n    ///         governance so the fee can never be set to an extractive level\n    ///         that would starve the staker reward pool.\n    uint16 public constant MAX_PROTOCOL_TREASURY_FEE = 1_000;\n\n    /// @notice Hard upper bound on `publishingConvictionEpochs`.\n    ///\n    /// `DKGPublishingConvictionNFT._settleElapsed` / `_finalSweep` loop\n    /// `lockDurationEpochs` times in the worst case (dormant account\n    /// settled at expiry). Each iteration costs ~30\u201350k gas\n    /// (`windowSpent` SLOAD + one or two `epochStorage.addTokensToEpochRange`\n    /// writes + a `WindowSettled` event), so an unbounded\n    /// `publishingConvictionEpochs` (the previous cap was `uint16.max`)\n    /// would let governance brick PCAs by setting the parameter past\n    /// the block-gas budget. 60 chain epochs \u2248 5 years at a 1-month\n    /// epoch length and worst-cases at ~3M gas \u2014 comfortably below\n    /// the block limit while leaving room for the surrounding\n    /// `publish` / `topUp` / NFT-transfer work.\n    uint256 public constant MAX_PUBLISHING_CONVICTION_EPOCHS = 60;\n\n    // @dev Only transactions by HubController owner or one of the owners of the MultiSig Wallet\n    modifier onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner() {\n        _checkOwnerOrMultiSigOwner();\n        _;\n    }\n\n    constructor(address hubAddress, uint256 _v81ReleaseEpoch) HubDependent(hubAddress) {\n        minimumStake = 50_000 ether;\n        maximumStake = 10_000_000 ether;\n\n        stakeWithdrawalDelay = 28 days;\n        nodeAskUpdateDelay = 1 days;\n        operatorFeeUpdateDelay = 28 days;\n\n        opWalletsLimitOnProfileCreation = 50;\n        shardingTableSizeLimit = 500;\n\n        minimumRequiredSignatures = 3;\n\n        askUpperBoundFactor = 1467000000000000000;\n        askLowerBoundFactor = 533000000000000000;\n\n        maxOperatorFee = 10_000;\n\n        // Epoch when v8.1 was released on mainnet/testnet\n        // Change if you ever redeploy delegatorsInfo contract on either network\n        v81ReleaseEpoch = _v81ReleaseEpoch;\n        publishingConvictionEpochs = 12;\n\n        // 3% default. Dormant until `protocolTreasury` is set (defaults to\n        // the zero address), so a fresh deploy behaves exactly as before\n        // until governance opts in.\n        protocolTreasuryFee = 300;\n\n        // OT-RFC-53: constructor leaves the registration deposit at 0; the\n        // standard deploy sets the live value (100 TRAC) via a post-deploy\n        // script that calls `setContextGraphRegistrationDeposit`. This protects\n        // production automatically (no manual step, no silent-off) while keeping\n        // test fixtures \u2014 which don't run that script \u2014 unaffected. Governance\n        // can retune or disable it anytime.\n    }\n\n    function name() external pure virtual override returns (string memory) {\n        return _NAME;\n    }\n\n    function version() external pure virtual override returns (string memory) {\n        return _VERSION;\n    }\n\n    function setAskUpperBoundFactor(uint256 _askUpperBoundFactor) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        askUpperBoundFactor = _askUpperBoundFactor;\n    }\n\n    function setAskLowerBoundFactor(uint256 _askLowerBoundFactor) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        askLowerBoundFactor = _askLowerBoundFactor;\n    }\n\n    function setMinimumRequiredSignatures(uint256 _minimumRequiredSignatures) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        minimumRequiredSignatures = _minimumRequiredSignatures;\n\n        emit ParameterChanged(\"minimumRequiredSignatures\", _minimumRequiredSignatures);\n    }\n\n    function setMinimumStake(uint96 newMinimumStake) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        minimumStake = newMinimumStake;\n\n        emit ParameterChanged(\"minimumStake\", newMinimumStake);\n    }\n\n    function setMaximumStake(uint96 newMaximumStake) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        maximumStake = newMaximumStake;\n\n        emit ParameterChanged(\"maximumStake\", newMaximumStake);\n    }\n\n    function setStakeWithdrawalDelay(uint256 newStakeWithdrawalDelay) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        stakeWithdrawalDelay = newStakeWithdrawalDelay;\n\n        emit ParameterChanged(\"stakeWithdrawalDelay\", newStakeWithdrawalDelay);\n    }\n\n    function setNodeAskUpdateDelay(uint256 newNodeAskUpdateDelay) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        nodeAskUpdateDelay = newNodeAskUpdateDelay;\n\n        emit ParameterChanged(\"nodeAskUpdateDelay\", newNodeAskUpdateDelay);\n    }\n\n    function setOperatorFeeUpdateDelay(uint256 newOperatorFeeUpdateDelay) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        operatorFeeUpdateDelay = newOperatorFeeUpdateDelay;\n\n        emit ParameterChanged(\"operatorFeeUpdateDelay\", newOperatorFeeUpdateDelay);\n    }\n\n    function setOpWalletsLimitOnProfileCreation(\n        uint16 opWalletsLimitOnProfileCreation_\n    ) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        opWalletsLimitOnProfileCreation = opWalletsLimitOnProfileCreation_;\n\n        emit ParameterChanged(\"opWalletsLimitOnProfileCreation\", opWalletsLimitOnProfileCreation);\n    }\n\n    function setShardingTableSizeLimit(uint16 shardingTableSizeLimit_) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        // Reject 0: ShardingTable._insertNode now enforces this cap\n        // (`nodesCount >= limit` reverts ShardingTableIsFull), so a 0 limit would\n        // freeze ALL node admission (even the first insert), bricking staking. 0\n        // is never a meaningful table size \u2014 reject it rather than let it act as\n        // an implicit pause switch.\n        if (shardingTableSizeLimit_ == 0) revert ZeroShardingTableSizeLimit();\n        shardingTableSizeLimit = shardingTableSizeLimit_;\n\n        emit ParameterChanged(\"shardingTableSizeLimit\", shardingTableSizeLimit);\n    }\n\n    function setMaxOperatorFee(uint16 maxOperatorFee_) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        maxOperatorFee = maxOperatorFee_;\n\n        emit ParameterChanged(\"maxOperatorFee\", maxOperatorFee);\n    }\n\n    function setV81ReleaseEpoch(uint256 _v81ReleaseEpoch) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        v81ReleaseEpoch = _v81ReleaseEpoch;\n\n        emit ParameterChanged(\"v81ReleaseEpoch\", _v81ReleaseEpoch);\n    }\n\n    function setPublishingConvictionEpochs(\n        uint256 _publishingConvictionEpochs\n    ) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        require(_publishingConvictionEpochs > 0, \"publishingConvictionEpochs must be > 0\");\n        // See `MAX_PUBLISHING_CONVICTION_EPOCHS` for the gas-budget\n        // rationale. The previous `<= type(uint16).max` bound permitted\n        // values that would gas-out PCA settlement.\n        require(\n            _publishingConvictionEpochs <= MAX_PUBLISHING_CONVICTION_EPOCHS,\n            \"publishingConvictionEpochs too large\"\n        );\n        publishingConvictionEpochs = _publishingConvictionEpochs;\n\n        emit ParameterChanged(\"publishingConvictionEpochs\", _publishingConvictionEpochs);\n    }\n\n    function setContextGraphRegistrationDeposit(uint96 amount) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        contextGraphRegistrationDeposit = amount;\n\n        emit ParameterChanged(\"contextGraphRegistrationDeposit\", amount);\n    }\n\n    function setProtocolTreasuryFee(uint16 protocolTreasuryFee_) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        // See `MAX_PROTOCOL_TREASURY_FEE` for the rationale on the upper\n        // bound. 0 is allowed (disables the fee while keeping the recipient\n        // wired) \u2014 the floor is enforced implicitly by the unsigned type.\n        require(protocolTreasuryFee_ <= MAX_PROTOCOL_TREASURY_FEE, \"protocolTreasuryFee too large\");\n        protocolTreasuryFee = protocolTreasuryFee_;\n\n        emit ParameterChanged(\"protocolTreasuryFee\", protocolTreasuryFee_);\n    }\n\n    function setProtocolTreasury(address protocolTreasury_) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        protocolTreasury = protocolTreasury_;\n\n        emit ProtocolTreasurySet(protocolTreasury_);\n    }\n\n    function _isMultiSigOwner(address multiSigAddress) internal view returns (bool) {\n        // First check if the address has contract code\n        uint256 size;\n        assembly {\n            size := extcodesize(multiSigAddress)\n        }\n\n        // If no contract code, it's an EOA, not a multisig\n        if (size == 0) {\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        try ICustodian(multiSigAddress).getOwners() returns (address[] memory multiSigOwners) {\n            for (uint256 i = 0; i < multiSigOwners.length; i++) {\n                if (msg.sender == multiSigOwners[i]) {\n                    return true;\n                }\n            }\n        } catch {\n            // Not a multisig or call reverted; treat as not owner.\n        }\n\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    function _checkOwnerOrMultiSigOwner() internal view virtual {\n        address hubOwner = hub.owner();\n        if (msg.sender != hubOwner && msg.sender != address(hub) && !_isMultiSigOwner(hubOwner)) {\n            revert(\"Only Hub Owner, Hub, or Multisig Owner can call\");\n        }\n    }\n}\n","keccak256":"0xcfa8ee19dacc2be0de28973802d18037bfac66537db226afc21d259611c5bac2","license":"Apache-2.0"},"contracts/storage/ProfileStorage.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\n\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\n\nimport {HubDependent} from \"../abstract/HubDependent.sol\";\nimport {ProfileLib} from \"../libraries/ProfileLib.sol\";\nimport {INamed} from \"../interfaces/INamed.sol\";\nimport {IVersioned} from \"../interfaces/IVersioned.sol\";\n\ncontract ProfileStorage is INamed, IVersioned, HubDependent {\n    string private constant _NAME = \"ProfileStorage\";\n    // Bumped 1.0.0 -> 1.1.0: ProfileInfo struct extended with relayCapable\n    // (RFC 04 v0.3 / Issue #461). New mapping reads on existing keys return\n    // false for the new field. Multiaddrs were briefly added on a prior\n    // revision but are deliberately not stored on Profile (RFC 04 \u00a75.2).\n    // 10.0.3 -> 10.0.4: active-fee getters (fee / percentage / effective-date)\n    // centralized in `_activeOperatorFee`, fixing the `operatorFees[length - 2]`\n    // underflow panic on the single-not-yet-effective-fee state (the effective-date\n    // getter still had it).\n    string private constant _VERSION = \"10.0.4\";\n\n    event ProfileCreated(uint72 indexed identityId, string nodeName, bytes nodeId, uint16 initialOperatorFee);\n    event ProfileDeleted(uint72 indexed identityId, bytes nodeId);\n    event NodeNameUpdated(uint72 indexed identityId, string oldName, string newName);\n    event NodeIdUpdated(uint72 indexed identityId, bytes oldNodeId, bytes newNodeId);\n    event NodeAskUpdated(uint72 indexed identityId, uint96 oldAsk, uint96 newAsk);\n    event OperatorFeeAdded(uint72 indexed identityId, uint16 feePercentage, uint256 effectiveDate);\n    event OperatorFeesReplaced(\n        uint72 indexed identityId,\n        uint16 oldFeePercentage,\n        uint16 newFeePercentage,\n        uint256 effectiveDate\n    );\n    event OperatorFeesUpdated(uint72 indexed identityId, ProfileLib.OperatorFee[] operatorFees);\n    // RFC 04 v0.3: relay-capability flag (multiaddrs live in attestation KAs, not Profile).\n    event RelayCapabilityUpdated(uint72 indexed identityId, bool oldValue, bool newValue);\n\n    mapping(uint72 => ProfileLib.ProfileInfo) public profiles;\n    mapping(string => bool) public isNameTaken;\n    mapping(bytes => bool) public nodeIdsList;\n    mapping(uint72 => uint256) public askUpdateCooldown;\n\n    constructor(address hubAddress) HubDependent(hubAddress) {}\n\n    function name() external pure override returns (string memory) {\n        return _NAME;\n    }\n\n    function version() external pure override returns (string memory) {\n        return _VERSION;\n    }\n\n    function createProfile(\n        uint72 identityId,\n        string calldata nodeName,\n        bytes calldata nodeId,\n        uint16 initialOperatorFee\n    ) external onlyContracts {\n        ProfileLib.ProfileInfo storage profile = profiles[identityId];\n        profile.name = nodeName;\n        profile.nodeId = nodeId;\n        profile.operatorFees.push(ProfileLib.OperatorFee(initialOperatorFee, block.timestamp));\n        nodeIdsList[nodeId] = true;\n\n        emit ProfileCreated(identityId, nodeName, nodeId, initialOperatorFee);\n    }\n\n    function getProfile(\n        uint72 identityId\n    )\n        external\n        view\n        returns (\n            string memory,\n            bytes memory,\n            uint96,\n            ProfileLib.OperatorFee[] memory,\n            bool\n        )\n    {\n        ProfileLib.ProfileInfo storage profile = profiles[identityId];\n\n        return (\n            profile.name,\n            profile.nodeId,\n            profile.ask,\n            profile.operatorFees,\n            profile.relayCapable\n        );\n    }\n\n    function deleteProfile(uint72 identityId) external onlyContracts {\n        bytes memory nodeId = profiles[identityId].nodeId;\n        nodeIdsList[nodeId] = false;\n        delete profiles[identityId];\n\n        emit ProfileDeleted(identityId, nodeId);\n    }\n\n    function getName(uint72 identityId) external view returns (string memory) {\n        return profiles[identityId].name;\n    }\n\n    function setName(uint72 identityId, string memory _name) external onlyContracts {\n        ProfileLib.ProfileInfo storage profile = profiles[identityId];\n        string memory oldName = profile.name;\n\n        profile.name = _name;\n\n        emit NodeNameUpdated(identityId, oldName, _name);\n    }\n\n    function getNodeId(uint72 identityId) external view returns (bytes memory) {\n        return profiles[identityId].nodeId;\n    }\n\n    function setNodeId(uint72 identityId, bytes calldata nodeId) external onlyContracts {\n        ProfileLib.ProfileInfo storage profile = profiles[identityId];\n        bytes memory oldNodeId = profile.nodeId;\n\n        nodeIdsList[oldNodeId] = false;\n        profile.nodeId = nodeId;\n        nodeIdsList[nodeId] = true;\n\n        emit NodeIdUpdated(identityId, oldNodeId, nodeId);\n    }\n\n    function setAsk(uint72 identityId, uint96 ask) external onlyContracts {\n        ProfileLib.ProfileInfo storage profile = profiles[identityId];\n        uint96 oldAsk = profile.ask;\n\n        profile.ask = ask;\n\n        emit NodeAskUpdated(identityId, oldAsk, ask);\n    }\n\n    function setAskUpdateCooldown(uint72 identityId, uint256 cooldownEnd) external onlyContracts {\n        askUpdateCooldown[identityId] = cooldownEnd;\n    }\n\n    function getAsk(uint72 identityId) external view returns (uint96) {\n nodeEpochIndex[identityId][epoch];\n        uint256 n = ei.mid.length;\n        // M6 \u2014 no first-sentinel anymore; absent checkpoint \u2192 0 (natural\n        //      pre-any-proof default under D26's epoch-local accumulator).\n        if (n == 0) {\n            return 0;\n        }\n        // Largest i with mid[i].timestamp <= ts via binary search.\n        uint256 lo = 0;\n        uint256 hi = n;\n        while (lo < hi) {\n            uint256 mid = (lo + hi) >> 1;\n            if (ei.mid[mid].timestamp <= ts) {\n                lo = mid + 1;\n            } else {\n                hi = mid;\n            }\n        }\n        if (lo == 0) {\n            return 0;\n        }\n        return ei.mid[lo - 1].scorePerStake36;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @dev Returns the last settled score 10^36\n     */\n    function getDelegatorLastSettledNodeEpochScorePerStake(\n        uint256 epoch,\n        uint72 identityId,\n        bytes32 delegatorKey\n    ) external view returns (uint256) {\n devdoc.details: M5 — this contract does NOT implement `INamed`. ERC-721's `name()`      already occupies that function selector with a different contract —      the collection display name returned to wallets — so an `INamed`      implementation would collide. Use `contractName()` below for the      dev-facing contract id (matches other V10 contracts' INamed value).

ERC721IncorrectOwner(address,uint256,add.details: Indicates an error related to the ownership over a particular token. Used in transfers.

params.owner: Address of the current owner of a token.
params.sender: Address whose tokens are being transferred.

ERC721InsufficientApproval(address,uint2.details: Indicates a failure with the `operator`’s approval. Used in transfers.

params.operator: Address that may be allowed to operate on tokens without being their owner.

ERC721InvalidApprover(address).details: Indicates a failure with the `approver` of a token to be approved. Used in approvals.

ERC721InvalidOperator(address).details: Indicates a failure with the `operator` to be approved. Used in approvals.

params.operator: Address that may be allowed to operate on tokens without being their owner.

ERC721InvalidOwner(address).details: Indicates that an address can't be an owner. For example, `address(0)` is a forbidden owner in ERC-20. Used in balance queries.

params.owner: Address of the current owner of a token.

ERC721InvalidReceiver(address).details: Indicates a failure with the token `receiver`. Used in transfers.

params.receiver: Address to which tokens are being transferred.

ERC721InvalidSender(address).details: Indicates a failure with the token `sender`. Used in transfers.

params.sender: Address whose tokens are being transferred.

ERC721NonexistentToken(uint256).details: Indicates a `tokenId` whose `owner` is the zero address.

ERC721OutOfBoundsIndex(address,uint256).details: An `owner`'s token query was out of bounds for `index`. NOTE: The owner being `address(0)` indicates a global out of bounds index.

Approval(address,address,uint256).details: Emitted when `owner` enables `approved` to manage the `tokenId` token.

ApprovalForAll(address,address,bool).details: Emitted when `owner` enables or disables (`approved`) `operator` to manage all of its assets.

OperatorFeeMigrated(uint72,address,uint9.details: Reconciliation: total migration credit issued = Σ `MigrationStarted`         (delegator stake) + Σ `OperatorFeeMigrated` (operator fees). An         indexer must sum BOTH events or it undercounts operators.

Transfer(address,address,uint256).details: Emitted when `tokenId` token is transferred from `from` to `to`.

approve(address,uint256).details: Gives permission to `to` to transfer `tokenId` token to another account. The approval is cleared when the token is transferred. Only a single account can be approved at a time, so approving the zero address clears previous approvals. Requirements: - The caller must own the token or be an approved operator. - `tokenId` must exist. Emits an {Approval} event.

balanceOf(address).details: Returns the number of tokens in ``owner``'s account.

getApproved(uint256).details: Returns the account approved for `tokenId` token. Requirements: - `tokenId` must exist.

isApprovedForAll(address,address).details: Returns if the `operator` is allowed to manage all of the assets of `owner`. See {setApprovalForAll}

ownerOf(uint256).details: Returns the owner of the `tokenId` token. Requirements: - `tokenId` must exist.

redelegate(uint256,uint72).details: D25 — in-place node swap. Unlike `relock` (which burns and      mints because tier / multiplier / expiry all change), a      redelegation is a routing decision: the lock clock keeps      ticking on the same `expiryTimestamp`, the reward cursor      (`lastClaimedEpoch`, `cumulativeRewardsClaimed`,      `migrationEpoch`) carries through unchanged, and the tokenId      itself persists so wallets and marketplaces see a stable      asset. StakingV10 drives the CSS `updateOnRedelegate`      primitive which moves per-node effective-stake contributions      and pending expiry deltas across at `currentEpoch`.

relock(uint256,uint40).details: D21 — NFTs are ephemeral. Relock burns the old NFT and mints a      fresh one at `newTokenId = ++nextTokenId`. `StakingV10.relock`      drives the D23 `createNewPositionFromExisting` primitive on CSS,      which preserves `cumulativeRewardsClaimed`, `lastClaimedEpoch`,      and `migrationEpoch` on the new tokenId; indexers that need to      track a delegator's history across relocks follow the      `PositionRelocked(oldTokenId, newTokenId, ...)` event surfaced      here (and the CSS-level `PositionReplaced` with the full reward      stat continuity).      CEI ordering — state changes first, NFT mint last:        1. `stakingV10.relock` — drives CSS's `createNewPositionFromExisting`           which itself asserts the new slot is empty           (`positions[newTokenId].identityId == 0`). That assertion is           a CSS-state check, not an NFT-existence check, so the new           NFT does NOT need to exist yet.        2. `_burn(oldTokenId)` — removes the old NFT after CSS has           moved the position. A mid-call revert leaves BOTH NFT and           position state intact at the old tokenId.        3. `_mint(msg.sender, newTokenId)` — last, so the wrapper           never observes a half-built burn-mint state. `_mint`           (not `_safeMint`) is intentional: contract callers           without `IERC721Receiver` are part of the supported           caller set, including any contract holding an existing           position from a prior `_mint`-era relock.

safeTransferFrom(address,address,uint256.details: Safely transfers `tokenId` token from `from` to `to`, checking first that contract recipients are aware of the ERC-721 protocol to prevent tokens from being forever locked. Requirements: - `from` cannot be the zero address. - `to` cannot be the zero address. - `tokenId` token must exist and be owned by `from`. - If the caller is not `from`, it must have been allowed to move this token by either {approve} or   {setApprovalForAll}. - If `to` refers to a smart contract, it must implement {IERC721Receiver-onERC721Received}, which is called upon   a safe transfer. Emits a {Transfer} event.

Safely transfers `tokenId` token from `from` to `to`. Requirements: - `from` cannot be the zero address. - `to` cannot be the zero address. - `tokenId` token must exist and be owned by `from`. - If the caller is not `from`, it must be approved to move this token by either {approve} or {setApprovalForAll}. - If `to` refers to a smart contract, it must implement {IERC721Receiver-onERC721Received}, which is called upon   a safe transfer. Emits a {Transfer} event.

setApprovalForAll(address,bool).details: Approve or remove `operator` as an operator for the caller. Operators can call {transferFrom} or {safeTransferFrom} for any token owned by the caller. Requirements: - The `operator` cannot be the address zero. Emits an {ApprovalForAll} event.

supportsInterface(bytes4).details: Returns true if this contract implements the interface defined by `interfaceId`. See the corresponding https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-165#how-interfaces-are-identified[ERC section] to learn more about how these ids are created. This function call must use less than 30 000 gas.

tokenByIndex(uint256).details: Returns a token ID at a given `index` of all the tokens stored by the contract. Use along with {totalSupply} to enumerate all tokens.

tokenOfOwnerByIndex(address,uint256).details: Returns a token ID owned by `owner` at a given `index` of its token list. Use along with {balanceOf} to enumerate all of ``owner``'s tokens.

tokenURI(uint256).details: Returns the Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) for `tokenId` token.

totalSupply().details: Returns the total amount of tokens stored by the contract.

transferFrom(address,address,uint256).details: Transfers `tokenId` token from `from` to `to`. WARNING: Note that the caller is responsible to confirm that the recipient is capable of receiving ERC-721 or else they may be permanently lost. Usage of {safeTransferFrom} prevents loss, though the caller must understand this adds an external call which potentially creates a reentrancy vulnerability. Requirements: - `from` cannot be the zero address. - `to` cannot be the zero address. - `tokenId` token must be owned by `from`. - If the caller is not `from`, it must be approved to move this token by either {approve} or {setApprovalForAll}. Emits a {Transfer} event.

withdraw(uint256).details: D14 — no request/cancel/finalize dance, no address-timer      delay. Pre-expiry reverts `LockStillActive` at StakingV10.      Q3 — rewards are auto-claimed inside `StakingV10.withdraw`      before the final drain, so the user sees a single button in      the UI. Full-only by design (Q1) — a user wanting to keep      some TRAC staked should withdraw and re-stake the remainder      (tier 0 with 1x is effectively liquid).

InvalidIdentityId().notice: L8 — rejected at the wrapper layer when a mint-path or         redelegate call would otherwise forward a zero identity to         StakingV10 (which uses `identityId == 0` internally as the         "no position" sentinel).

NothingToMigrate().notice: Thrown by `adminMigrateToCredit` when the delegator         has no V8 stake across the given source nodes (nothing drained,         so no credit would be created). `adminDrainBatch` SKIPS such         entries instead of reverting.

Allocated(address,uint256,uint72,uint96,.notice: Emitted when migration credit is allocated into a fresh V10         conviction position. `creditApplied` is true when the tier-6/12         conviction lock-credit was applied (any 6/12 migration allocation;         universal).

MigrationBatchFinalized(uint256).notice: Emitted by `finalizeMigrationBatch` when the DAO closes the         V10 migration window by setting the `v10LaunchEpoch` marker         on CSS. Retroactive-attribution analyses use this epoch.

MigrationStarted(address,uint96).notice: Emitted when a delegator's V8 stake is drained into migration         credit by the admin sweep. `credited` is the total         moved into that delegator's credit by this event.

OperatorFeeMigrated(uint72,address,uint9.notice: Emitted when a node's V8 operator fee (resting balance + any open         fee-withdrawal request) is drained into the operator's migration         credit by the admin sweep. Keyed by `identityId` so         per-node fee migration reconciles against the V8 vault; `operator`         is the validated current ADMIN_KEY holder that was credited.

PositionCreated(address,uint256,uint72,u.notice: Emitted by `createConviction` and `convertToNFT` after the         NFT is minted. The authoritative position-created event (with         raw / expiryTimestamp / multiplier18) is emitted by         `ConvictionStakingStorage.createPosition` via `StakingV10.stake`;         this wrapper-layer event is kept so off-chain indexers that         watch the NFT contract alone still see the mint.

PositionRedelegated(uint256,uint72,uint7.notice: Emitted by `redelegate` after the position's identity is         mutated in place. D25 — tokenId, `expiryTimestamp`, lock tier,         multiplier, and reward cursor are all preserved; only the         node assignment changes. Global totals are invariant; only         per-node effective stake moves. Authoritative event (same         shape) is emitted by `ConvictionStakingStorage` via         `updateOnRedelegate`; this wrapper-layer event is kept so         off-chain indexers watching the NFT contract alone still         see the transition.

PositionRelocked(uint256,uint256,uint40).notice: Emitted by `relock` after the old NFT is burned and a fresh         one is minted under a new lock tier. D21 — NFTs are ephemeral;         off-chain indexers follow `oldTokenId → newTokenId` via this         event (and `PositionReplaced` on `ConvictionStakingStorage`,         which carries the full reward-stat continuity).

PositionWithdrawn(uint256,uint96).notice: Emitted by `withdraw` after CSS deletes the position and TRAC         is released from the vault to the owner. The NFT is burned         immediately after. Authoritative event (with `staker`) is         emitted by `StakingV10.withdraw`; this wrapper-layer event         is kept so off-chain indexers watching the NFT contract         alone still see the exit.

SCALE18().notice: 1e18 fixed-point scale shared with `ConvictionStakingStorage`.         Tier table and reward math all use this scale.

adminDrainBatch(address[],uint72[]).notice: Bulk admin-push drain. Each index `i` is ONE (delegator, node)         pair — the flattened form matches the V8 storage key and the         off-chain DelegatorsInfo enumeration, giving even per-pair gas so         the driver packs uniform chunks. Pairs with nothing to drain are         SKIPPED (not reverted), so a chunk mixing already-drained and         fresh pairs still lands and re-running a chunk after a partial         failure is safe (`drainV8ToCredit` is idempotent — a zeroed slot         yields 0). Amounts are NOT passed in — they are read on-chain from         V8 state, so the credit is exactly what was drained. Gate:         `onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner`. Emits one `MigrationStarted` per pair         that moved credit.

adminDrainOperatorFeesBatch(uint72[],add.notice: Bulk operator-fee drain — companion to `adminDrainBatch` for the         node side. Each index `i` is ONE (node, operator) pair: the V8         operator fee on `identityIds[i]` (resting balance + open         withdrawal request) is moved into `operators[i]`'s migration         credit (the SAME bucket as delegator         stake). `operators[i]` MUST currently hold ADMIN_KEY on the node         (validated in `StakingV10.drainOperatorFeeToCredit`, which         REVERTS a stale/wrong address) — so a mis-resolved operator         reverts the whole batch rather than crediting wrongly; the         off-chain sweep re-resolves and retries. Nodes with no fee are         SKIPPED (idempotent: a re-drained node yields 0). Amounts are         read on-chain, never passed in. Gate: `onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner`.         Emits one `OperatorFeeMigrated` per node that moved credit.

adminMigrateToCredit(address,uint72[]).notice: Single-delegator admin drain — move `delegator`'s V8 stake across         `sourceNodes` into THEIR migration credit (no allocation). See         `adminDrainBatch` for the bulk sweep. Gate:         `onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner`. Reverts `NothingToMigrate` if nothing         was drained (caller-error guard on an intentional single call).

allocate(uint72,uint96,uint40).notice: Spend `amount` of the caller's migration credit into a fresh V10         conviction position on `targetNode` at `lockTier`. Repeatable         until the credit is spent. Any tier-6/12 allocation receives the         conviction lock-credit (universal).

claim(uint256).notice: Walk unclaimed epochs for the position, accumulate reward,         and bank it into the `ConvictionStakingStorage` rewards         bucket. Updates `lastClaimedEpoch`.

createConviction(uint72,uint96,uint40).notice: Mint a fresh NFT-backed staking position on `identityId` with         `amount` TRAC under the `lockTier` tier. Valid tiers are         whatever `CSS.getTier(lockTier).active == true`; the seeded         baseline is tier 0 (rest state, 1x, no lock) plus 1/3/6/12         (30d/90d/180d/366d → 1.5x/2x/3.5x/6x). All tiers — including         tier 0 — produce an NFT; every V10 staking position is an NFT.

finalizeMigrationBatch(uint256).notice: DAO closer — D11. Sets the `v10LaunchEpoch` marker on         `ConvictionStakingStorage` to formally close the V10         migration window. After this, late drains are still possible via         `adminDrainBatch` / `adminMigrateToCredit`, but the launch-epoch         field is the canonical off-chain cut-off for retroactive         reward / analytics windows.

nextTokenId().notice: Monotonic token id counter. The first mint produces tokenId 1         (L2 — tokenId 0 is reserved as a sentinel so `ownerOf(0)` is         always "unambiguously nothing"). `++nextTokenId` bumps the         counter before use, so `nextTokenId == N` means "N positions         have been minted (ever)".

redelegate(uint256,uint72).notice: Move a position from its current node to `newIdentityId`.         Per-node effective stake moves; global totals invariant.         The tokenId is STABLE — the caller's NFT asset identity is         preserved across the redelegation, only the node it points         at changes.

relock(uint256,uint40).notice: Post-expiry re-commit of an existing position to a new lock         tier. Raw stake unchanged; multiplier + expiry shift.

selfMigrate(uint72[]).notice: Self-service straggler backstop. The connected wallet drains ITS         OWN V8 stake (keyed by `keccak256(msg.sender)`) across `sourceNodes`         into its own migration credit. Admin-push (`adminDrainBatch`) is the         primary path; this exists so any delegator the off-chain sweep         missed can never be stranded. Permissionless and self-validating —         you can only ever drain the V8 key that hashes from your own         address, into your own credit. Works after V8 Staking is         unregistered (the drain goes through StakingStorage directly); the         worker's freeze gate means it is only callable once V8 Staking is         frozen (so it cannot race live V8 reward/sharding accounting).

selfMigrateOperatorFee(uint72).notice: Self-service operator-fee backstop: the node admin (msg.sender,         validated against ADMIN_KEY inside `drainOperatorFeeToCredit`)         drains the node's V8 operator fee into its own migration credit.         Same freeze-gated, post-unregister-safe properties as `selfMigrate`.

setConvictionCreditSeconds(uint40).notice: Set the V8→V10 conviction lock-credit (seconds). Owner-settable;         set it before running the admin sweep. CSS caps it below the         tier-6 lock duration so a position's expiry cannot underflow.

withdraw(uint256).notice: Atomic full withdrawal. Pays out the position's entire `raw`         balance (post-auto-claim) to the owner and burns the NFT in         a single transaction. Caller must own the NFT.
